extension RoleCollectionQueryWhere
    on QueryBuilder<RoleCollection, RoleCollection, QWhereClause> {
  QueryBuilder<RoleCollection, RoleCollection, QAfterWhereClause> idEqualTo(
      Id id) {
    return QueryBuilder.apply(this, (query) {
      return query.addWhereClause(IdWhereClause.between(
        lower: id,
        upper: id,
      ));
    });
  }

  QueryBuilder<RoleCollection, RoleCollection, QAfterWhereClause> idNotEqualTo(
      Id id) {
    return QueryBuilder.apply(this, (query) {
      if (query.whereSort == Sort.asc) {
        return query
            .addWhereClause(
              IdWhereClause.lessThan(upper: id, includeUpper: false),
            )
            .addWhereClause(
              IdWhereClause.greaterThan(lower: id, includeLower: false),
            );
      } else {
        return query
            .addWhereClause(
              IdWhereClause.greaterThan(lower: id, includeLower: false),
            )
            .addWhereClause(
              IdWhereClause.lessThan(upper: id, includeUpper: false),
            );
      }
    });
  }

  QueryBuilder<RoleCollection, RoleCollection, QAfterWhereClause> idGreaterThan(
      Id id,
      {bool include = false}) {
    return QueryBuilder.apply(this, (query) {
      return query.addWhereClause(
        IdWhereClause.greaterThan(lower: id, includeLower: include),
      );
    });
  }

  QueryBuilder<RoleCollection, RoleCollection, QAfterWhereClause> idLessThan(
      Id id,
      {bool include = false}) {
    return QueryBuilder.apply(this, (query) {
      return query.addWhereClause(
        IdWhereClause.lessThan(upper: id, includeUpper: include),
      );
    });
  }

  QueryBuilder<RoleCollection, RoleCollection, QAfterWhereClause> idBetween(
    Id lowerId,
    Id upperId, {
    bool includeLower = true,
    bool includeUpper = true,
  }) {
    return QueryBuilder.apply(this, (query) {
      return query.addWhereClause(IdWhereClause.between(
        lower: lowerId,
        includeLower: includeLower,
        upper: upperId,
        includeUpper: includeUpper,
      ));
    });
  }

  QueryBuilder<RoleCollection, RoleCollection, QAfterWhereClause> uuidEqualTo(
      String uuid) {
    return QueryBuilder.apply(this, (query) {
      return query.addWhereClause(IndexWhereClause.equalTo(
        indexName: r'uuid',
        value: [uuid],
      ));
    });
  }

  QueryBuilder<RoleCollection, RoleCollection, QAfterWhereClause>
      uuidNotEqualTo(String uuid) {
    return QueryBuilder.apply(this, (query) {
      if (query.whereSort == Sort.asc) {
        return query
            .addWhereClause(IndexWhereClause.between(
              indexName: r'uuid',
              lower: [],
              upper: [uuid],
              includeUpper: false,
            ))
            .addWhereClause(IndexWhereClause.between(
              indexName: r'uuid',
              lower: [uuid],
              includeLower: false,
              upper: [],
            ));
      } else {
        return query
            .addWhereClause(IndexWhereClause.between(
              indexName: r'uuid',
              lower: [uuid],
              includeLower: false,
              upper: [],
            ))
            .addWhereClause(IndexWhereClause.between(
              indexName: r'uuid',
              lower: [],
              upper: [uuid],
              includeUpper: false,
            ));
      }
    });
  }

  QueryBuilder<RoleCollection, RoleCollection, QAfterWhereClause> nameEqualTo(
      String name) {
    return QueryBuilder.apply(this, (query) {
      return query.addWhereClause(IndexWhereClause.equalTo(
        indexName: r'name',
        value: [name],
      ));
    });
  }

  QueryBuilder<RoleCollection, RoleCollection, QAfterWhereClause>
      nameNotEqualTo(String name) {
    return QueryBuilder.apply(this, (query) {
      if (query.whereSort == Sort.asc) {
        return query
            .addWhereClause(IndexWhereClause.between(
              indexName: r'name',
              lower: [],
              upper: [name],
              includeUpper: false,
            ))
            .addWhereClause(IndexWhereClause.between(
              indexName: r'name',
              lower: [name],
              includeLower: false,
              upper: [],
            ));
      } else {
        return query
            .addWhereClause(IndexWhereClause.between(
              indexName: r'name',
              lower: [name],
              includeLower: false,
              upper: [],
            ))
            .addWhereClause(IndexWhereClause.between(
              indexName: r'name',
              lower: [],
              upper: [name],
              includeUpper: false,
            ));
      }
    });
  }
}

int _auditLogCollectionEstimateSize(
  AuditLogCollection object,
  List<int> offsets,
  Map<Type, List<int>> allOffsets,
) {
  var bytesCount = offsets.last;
  bytesCount += 3 + object.action.length * 3;
  bytesCount += 3 + object.details.length * 3;
  bytesCount += 3 + object.module.length * 3;
  bytesCount += 3 + object.userId.length * 3;
  bytesCount += 3 + object.uuid.length * 3;
  return bytesCount;
}

void _auditLogCollectionSerialize(
  AuditLogCollection object,
  IsarWriter writer,
  List<int> offsets,
  Map<Type, List<int>> allOffsets,
) {
  writer.writeString(offsets[0], object.action);
  writer.writeString(offsets[1], object.details);
  writer.writeString(offsets[2], object.module);
  writer.writeDateTime(offsets[3], object.timestamp);
  writer.writeString(offsets[4], object.userId);
  writer.writeString(offsets[5], object.uuid);
}

  Id id,
  IsarReader reader,

) {
  final object = AuditLogCollection();
  object.action = reader.readString(offsets[0]);
  object.details = reader.readString(offsets[1]);
  object.id = id;
  object.module = reader.readString(offsets[2]);
  object.timestamp = reader.readDateTime(offsets[3]);
  object.userId = reader.readString(offsets[4]);
  object.uuid = reader.readString(offsets[5]);
  return object;
}

  QueryBuilder<AuditLogCollection, AuditLogCollection, QAfterWhereClause>

      if (query.whereSort == Sort.asc) {
        return query
            .addWhereClause(
              IdWhereClause.lessThan(upper: id, includeUpper: false),
            )
            .addWhereClause(
              IdWhereClause.greaterThan(lower: id, includeLower: false),
            );
      } else {
        return query
            .addWhereClause(
              IdWhereClause.greaterThan(lower: id, includeLower: false),
            )
            .addWhereClause(
              IdWhereClause.lessThan(upper: id, includeUpper: false),
            );
      }
    });
  }

  QueryBuilder<AuditLogCollection, AuditLogCollection, QAfterWhereClause>
      idGreaterThan(Id id, {bool include = false}) {
    return QueryBuilder.apply(this, (query) {
      return query.addWhereClause(
        IdWhereClause.greaterThan(lower: id, includeLower: include),

int _securityLogCollectionEstimateSize(
  SecurityLogCollection object,
  List<int> offsets,
  Map<Type, List<int>> allOffsets,
) {
  var bytesCount = offsets.last;
  bytesCount += 3 + object.eventType.length * 3;
  bytesCount += 3 + object.ipAddress.length * 3;
  bytesCount += 3 + object.severity.length * 3;
  bytesCount += 3 + object.userId.length * 3;
  bytesCount += 3 + object.uuid.length * 3;
  return bytesCount;
}

  writer.writeString(offsets[5], object.uuid);
}

        includeLower: includeLower,
        upper: [upperTimestamp],
        includeUpper: includeUpper,
      ));
    });
  }

import 'package:isar/isar.dart';

part 'ai_collections.g.dart';

@collection
class AIModelCollection {
  Id id = Isar.autoIncrement;

  @Index(unique: true, replace: true)
  late String uuid;

  @Index(caseSensitive: false)
  late String name;

  late String providerId;
  late String type; // chat, vision, etc.
  bool isEnabled = true;

  late String capabilitiesJson; // Store as JSON string
}

@collection
class AISessionCollection {
  Id id = Isar.autoIncrement;

  @Index(unique: true, replace: true)
  late String uuid;

  @Index()
  late String userId;

  late String title;
  late DateTime startTime;
  DateTime? lastMessageTime;

  late String messagesJson; // List of messages as JSON

  @Index()
  String? moduleContext; // 'sales', 'finance', etc.
}

@collection
class AIUsageCollection {
  Id id = Isar.autoIncrement;

  @Index()
  late String modelId;

  @Index()
  late DateTime timestamp;

  late int promptTokens;
  late int completionTokens;
  late int totalTokens;

  late double estimatedCost;
  late String userId;
}

@collection
class AIAutomationCollection {
  Id id = Isar.autoIncrement;

  @Index(unique: true, replace: true)
  late String uuid;

  @Index(caseSensitive: false)
  late String name;

  late String description;
  late String trigger; // schedule, event, manual
  late String actionJson;
  late String status; // active, paused, etc.
}

int _aISessionCollectionEstimateSize(
  AISessionCollection object,
  List<int> offsets,
  Map<Type, List<int>> allOffsets,
) {
  var bytesCount = offsets.last;
  bytesCount += 3 + object.messagesJson.length * 3;
  {
    final value = object.moduleContext;
    if (value != null) {
      bytesCount += 3 + value.length * 3;
    }
  }
  bytesCount += 3 + object.title.length * 3;
  bytesCount += 3 + object.userId.length * 3;
  bytesCount += 3 + object.uuid.length * 3;
  return bytesCount;
}

void _aISessionCollectionSerialize(
  AISessionCollection object,
  IsarWriter writer,
  List<int> offsets,
  Map<Type, List<int>> allOffsets,
) {
  writer.writeDateTime(offsets[0], object.lastMessageTime);
  writer.writeString(offsets[1], object.messagesJson);
  writer.writeString(offsets[2], object.moduleContext);
  writer.writeDateTime(offsets[3], object.startTime);
  writer.writeString(offsets[4], object.title);
  writer.writeString(offsets[5], object.userId);
  writer.writeString(offsets[6], object.uuid);
}

AISessionCollection _aISessionCollectionDeserialize(
  Id id,
  IsarReader reader,
  List<int> offsets,
  Map<Type, List<int>> allOffsets,
) {
  final object = AISessionCollection();
  object.id = id;
  object.lastMessageTime = reader.readDateTimeOrNull(offsets[0]);
  object.messagesJson = reader.readString(offsets[1]);
  object.moduleContext = reader.readStringOrNull(offsets[2]);
  object.startTime = reader.readDateTime(offsets[3]);
  object.title = reader.readString(offsets[4]);
  object.userId = reader.readString(offsets[5]);
  object.uuid = reader.readString(offsets[6]);
  return object;
}

    case 2:
      return (reader.readStringOrNull(offset)) as P;
    case 3:
      return (reader.readDateTime(offset)) as P;
    case 4:
      return (reader.readString(offset)) as P;

    case 6:
      return (reader.readString(offset)) as P;

      throw IsarError('Unknown property with id $propertyId');

int _aIUsageCollectionEstimateSize(
  AIUsageCollection object,
  List<int> offsets,
  Map<Type, List<int>> allOffsets,
) {
  var bytesCount = offsets.last;
  bytesCount += 3 + object.modelId.length * 3;
  bytesCount += 3 + object.userId.length * 3;
  return bytesCount;
}

void _aIUsageCollectionSerialize(
  AIUsageCollection object,
  IsarWriter writer,
  List<int> offsets,
  Map<Type, List<int>> allOffsets,
) {
  writer.writeLong(offsets[0], object.completionTokens);
  writer.writeDouble(offsets[1], object.estimatedCost);
  writer.writeString(offsets[2], object.modelId);
  writer.writeLong(offsets[3], object.promptTokens);
  writer.writeDateTime(offsets[4], object.timestamp);
  writer.writeLong(offsets[5], object.totalTokens);
  writer.writeString(offsets[6], object.userId);
}

AIUsageCollection _aIUsageCollectionDeserialize(
  Id id,
  IsarReader reader,
  List<int> offsets,
  Map<Type, List<int>> allOffsets,
) {
  final object = AIUsageCollection();
  object.completionTokens = reader.readLong(offsets[0]);
  object.estimatedCost = reader.readDouble(offsets[1]);
  object.id = id;
  object.modelId = reader.readString(offsets[2]);
  object.promptTokens = reader.readLong(offsets[3]);
  object.timestamp = reader.readDateTime(offsets[4]);
  object.totalTokens = reader.readLong(offsets[5]);
  object.userId = reader.readString(offsets[6]);
  return object;
}

P _aIUsageCollectionDeserializeProp<P>(
  IsarReader reader,
  int propertyId,
  int offset,
  Map<Type, List<int>> allOffsets,
) {
  switch (propertyId) {
    case 0:
      return (reader.readLong(offset)) as P;
    case 1:
      return (reader.readDouble(offset)) as P;
    case 2:
      return (reader.readString(offset)) as P;
    case 3:
      return (reader.readLong(offset)) as P;
    case 4:
      return (reader.readDateTime(offset)) as P;
    case 5:
      return (reader.readLong(offset)) as P;
    case 6:
      return (reader.readString(offset)) as P;
    default:
      throw IsarError('Unknown property with id $propertyId');
  }
}

int _aIAutomationCollectionEstimateSize(
  AIAutomationCollection object,
  List<int> offsets,
  Map<Type, List<int>> allOffsets,
) {
  var bytesCount = offsets.last;
  bytesCount += 3 + object.actionJson.length * 3;
  bytesCount += 3 + object.description.length * 3;
  bytesCount += 3 + object.name.length * 3;
  bytesCount += 3 + object.status.length * 3;
  bytesCount += 3 + object.trigger.length * 3;
  bytesCount += 3 + object.uuid.length * 3;
  return bytesCount;
}

  QueryBuilder<AIAutomationCollection, AIAutomationCollection,
      QAfterWhereClause> idNotEqualTo(Id id) {
    return QueryBuilder.apply(this, (query) {
      if (query.whereSort == Sort.asc) {
        return query
            .addWhereClause(
              IdWhereClause.lessThan(upper: id, includeUpper: false),
            )
            .addWhereClause(
              IdWhereClause.greaterThan(lower: id, includeLower: false),
            );
      } else {
        return query
            .addWhereClause(
              IdWhereClause.greaterThan(lower: id, includeLower: false),
            )
            .addWhereClause(
              IdWhereClause.lessThan(upper: id, includeUpper: false),
            );
      }
    });
  }

  writer.writeDouble(offsets[15], object.lifetimeSpent);

  writer.writeString(offsets[17], object.name);
  writer.writeDouble(offsets[18], object.outstandingBalance);
  writer.writeString(offsets[19], object.phone);
  writer.writeString(offsets[20], object.salesRepId);
  writer.writeString(offsets[21], object.segmentId);
  writer.writeStringList(offsets[22], object.tags);
  writer.writeString(offsets[23], object.taxId);
  writer.writeString(offsets[24], object.territoryId);
  writer.writeString(offsets[25], object.tier);
  writer.writeString(offsets[26], object.type);
  writer.writeDateTime(offsets[27], object.updatedAt);
  writer.writeString(offsets[28], object.uuid);
  writer.writeString(offsets[29], object.whatsapp);
}

  Id id,

) {
  final object = CustomerCollection();

  object.categoryId = reader.readStringOrNull(offsets[3]);

  object.companyName = reader.readStringOrNull(offsets[5]);
  object.contacts = reader.readObjectList<CustomerContactEmbedded>(
    offsets[6],
    CustomerContactEmbeddedSchema.deserialize,
    allOffsets,
    CustomerContactEmbedded(),
  );
  object.createdAt = reader.readDateTime(offsets[7]);
  object.creditLimit = reader.readDouble(offsets[8]);
  object.customerCode = reader.readString(offsets[9]);
  object.email = reader.readString(offsets[10]);
  object.groupIds = reader.readStringList(offsets[11]) ?? [];
  object.id = id;
  object.isCreditBlocked = reader.readBool(offsets[12]);
  object.isDeleted = reader.readBool(offsets[13]);
  object.lastPurchaseAt = reader.readDateTimeOrNull(offsets[14]);
  object.lifetimeSpent = reader.readDouble(offsets[15]);
  object.loyaltyPoints = reader.readLong(offsets[16]);
  object.name = reader.readString(offsets[17]);
  object.outstandingBalance = reader.readDouble(offsets[18]);
  object.phone = reader.readString(offsets[19]);
  object.salesRepId = reader.readStringOrNull(offsets[20]);
  object.segmentId = reader.readStringOrNull(offsets[21]);
  object.tags = reader.readStringList(offsets[22]) ?? [];
  object.taxId = reader.readStringOrNull(offsets[23]);
  object.territoryId = reader.readStringOrNull(offsets[24]);
  object.tier = reader.readString(offsets[25]);
  object.type = reader.readString(offsets[26]);
  object.updatedAt = reader.readDateTime(offsets[27]);
  object.uuid = reader.readString(offsets[28]);
  object.whatsapp = reader.readStringOrNull(offsets[29]);

      return query.addWhereClause(IdWhereClause.between(
        lower: id,
        upper: id,
      ));
    });
  }

  QueryBuilder<CustomerCollection, CustomerCollection, QAfterWhereClause>
      idNotEqualTo(Id id) {
    return QueryBuilder.apply(this, (query) {
      if (query.whereSort == Sort.asc) {
        return query
            .addWhereClause(
              IdWhereClause.lessThan(upper: id, includeUpper: false),
            )
            .addWhereClause(
              IdWhereClause.greaterThan(lower: id, includeLower: false),
            );
      } else {
        return query
            .addWhereClause(
              IdWhereClause.greaterThan(lower: id, includeLower: false),
            )
            .addWhereClause(
              IdWhereClause.lessThan(upper: id, includeUpper: false),
            );
      }
    });

int _salesTerritoryCollectionEstimateSize(
  SalesTerritoryCollection object,
  List<int> offsets,
  Map<Type, List<int>> allOffsets,
) {
  var bytesCount = offsets.last;
  bytesCount += 3 + object.code.length * 3;
  bytesCount += 3 + object.name.length * 3;
  {
    final value = object.parentId;
    if (value != null) {
      bytesCount += 3 + value.length * 3;
    }
  }
  bytesCount += 3 + object.region.length * 3;
  bytesCount += 3 + object.uuid.length * 3;
  return bytesCount;
}

extension CustomerInteractionCollectionQueryWhere on QueryBuilder<
    CustomerInteractionCollection,
    CustomerInteractionCollection,
    QWhereClause> {
  QueryBuilder<CustomerInteractionCollection, CustomerInteractionCollection,
      QAfterWhereClause> idEqualTo(Id id) {
    return QueryBuilder.apply(this, (query) {
      return query.addWhereClause(IdWhereClause.between(
        lower: id,
        upper: id,
      ));
    });
  }

  QueryBuilder<CustomerInteractionCollection, CustomerInteractionCollection,
      QAfterWhereClause> idNotEqualTo(Id id) {
    return QueryBuilder.apply(this, (query) {
      if (query.whereSort == Sort.asc) {
        return query
            .addWhereClause(
              IdWhereClause.lessThan(upper: id, includeUpper: false),
            )
            .addWhereClause(
              IdWhereClause.greaterThan(lower: id, includeLower: false),
            );
      } else {
        return query
            .addWhereClause(
              IdWhereClause.greaterThan(lower: id, includeLower: false),
            )
            .addWhereClause(
              IdWhereClause.lessThan(upper: id, includeUpper: false),
            );
      }
    });
  }

  QueryBuilder<CustomerInteractionCollection, CustomerInteractionCollection,
      QAfterWhereClause> idGreaterThan(Id id, {bool include = false}) {

  object.source = reader.readStringOrNull(offsets[8]);
  object.status = reader.readString(offsets[9]);
  object.territoryId = reader.readStringOrNull(offsets[10]);
  object.updatedAt = reader.readDateTime(offsets[11]);
  object.uuid = reader.readString(offsets[12]);

extension LeadCollectionQueryWhere
    on QueryBuilder<LeadCollection, LeadCollection, QWhereClause> {
  QueryBuilder<LeadCollection, LeadCollection, QAfterWhereClause> idEqualTo(
      Id id) {
    return QueryBuilder.apply(this, (query) {
      return query.addWhereClause(IdWhereClause.between(
        lower: id,
        upper: id,
      ));
    });
  }

  QueryBuilder<LeadCollection, LeadCollection, QAfterWhereClause> idNotEqualTo(
      Id id) {
    return QueryBuilder.apply(this, (query) {
      if (query.whereSort == Sort.asc) {
        return query
            .addWhereClause(
              IdWhereClause.lessThan(upper: id, includeUpper: false),
            )
            .addWhereClause(
              IdWhereClause.greaterThan(lower: id, includeLower: false),
            );
      } else {
        return query
            .addWhereClause(
              IdWhereClause.greaterThan(lower: id, includeLower: false),
            )
            .addWhereClause(
              IdWhereClause.lessThan(upper: id, includeUpper: false),
            );
      }
    });
  }

  QueryBuilder<LeadCollection, LeadCollection, QAfterWhereClause> idGreaterThan(
      Id id,
      {bool include = false}) {
    return QueryBuilder.apply(this, (query) {
      return query.addWhereClause(
        IdWhereClause.greaterThan(lower: id, includeLower: include),
      );
    });
  }

  QueryBuilder<LeadCollection, LeadCollection, QAfterWhereClause> idLessThan(
      Id id,
      {bool include = false}) {
    return QueryBuilder.apply(this, (query) {
      return query.addWhereClause(
        IdWhereClause.lessThan(upper: id, includeUpper: include),
      );
    });
  }

  QueryBuilder<LeadCollection, LeadCollection, QAfterWhereClause> idBetween(
    Id lowerId,
    Id upperId, {
    bool includeLower = true,
    bool includeUpper = true,
  }) {
    return QueryBuilder.apply(this, (query) {
      return query.addWhereClause(IdWhereClause.between(
        lower: lowerId,
        includeLower: includeLower,
        upper: upperId,
        includeUpper: includeUpper,

    });

int _activityCollectionEstimateSize(
  ActivityCollection object,
  List<int> offsets,
  Map<Type, List<int>> allOffsets,
) {
  var bytesCount = offsets.last;
  bytesCount += 3 + object.assignedToId.length * 3;
  {
    final value = object.customerId;
    if (value != null) {
      bytesCount += 3 + value.length * 3;
    }
  }
  {
    final value = object.description;
    if (value != null) {
      bytesCount += 3 + value.length * 3;
    }
  }
  {
    final value = object.leadId;
    if (value != null) {
      bytesCount += 3 + value.length * 3;
    }
  }
  {
    final value = object.opportunityId;
    if (value != null) {
      bytesCount += 3 + value.length * 3;
    }
  }
  bytesCount += 3 + object.priority.length * 3;
  {
    final value = object.salesOrderId;
    if (value != null) {
      bytesCount += 3 + value.length * 3;
    }
  }
  bytesCount += 3 + object.status.length * 3;
  {
    final value = object.ticketId;
    if (value != null) {
      bytesCount += 3 + value.length * 3;
    }
  }
  bytesCount += 3 + object.title.length * 3;
  bytesCount += 3 + object.type.length * 3;
  bytesCount += 3 + object.uuid.length * 3;
  return bytesCount;
}

void _activityCollectionSerialize(
  ActivityCollection object,
  IsarWriter writer,
  List<int> offsets,
  Map<Type, List<int>> allOffsets,
) {
  writer.writeString(offsets[0], object.assignedToId);
  writer.writeDateTime(offsets[1], object.completedAt);
  writer.writeString(offsets[2], object.customerId);
  writer.writeString(offsets[3], object.description);
  writer.writeString(offsets[4], object.leadId);
  writer.writeString(offsets[5], object.opportunityId);
  writer.writeString(offsets[6], object.priority);
  writer.writeDateTime(offsets[7], object.reminderAt);
  writer.writeBool(offsets[8], object.reminderEnabled);
  writer.writeString(offsets[9], object.salesOrderId);
  writer.writeDateTime(offsets[10], object.scheduledAt);
  writer.writeString(offsets[11], object.status);
  writer.writeString(offsets[12], object.ticketId);
  writer.writeString(offsets[13], object.title);
  writer.writeString(offsets[14], object.type);
  writer.writeString(offsets[15], object.uuid);
}

ActivityCollection _activityCollectionDeserialize(
  Id id,
  IsarReader reader,
  List<int> offsets,
  Map<Type, List<int>> allOffsets,
) {
  final object = ActivityCollection();
  object.assignedToId = reader.readString(offsets[0]);
  object.completedAt = reader.readDateTimeOrNull(offsets[1]);
  object.customerId = reader.readStringOrNull(offsets[2]);
  object.description = reader.readStringOrNull(offsets[3]);
  object.id = id;
  object.leadId = reader.readStringOrNull(offsets[4]);
  object.opportunityId = reader.readStringOrNull(offsets[5]);
  object.priority = reader.readString(offsets[6]);
  object.reminderAt = reader.readDateTimeOrNull(offsets[7]);
  object.reminderEnabled = reader.readBool(offsets[8]);
  object.salesOrderId = reader.readStringOrNull(offsets[9]);
  object.scheduledAt = reader.readDateTime(offsets[10]);
  object.status = reader.readString(offsets[11]);
  object.ticketId = reader.readStringOrNull(offsets[12]);
  object.title = reader.readString(offsets[13]);
  object.type = reader.readString(offsets[14]);
  object.uuid = reader.readString(offsets[15]);
  return object;
}

P _activityCollectionDeserializeProp<P>(
  IsarReader reader,
  int propertyId,
  int offset,
  Map<Type, List<int>> allOffsets,
) {
  switch (propertyId) {
    case 0:
      return (reader.readString(offset)) as P;
    case 1:
      return (reader.readDateTimeOrNull(offset)) as P;
    case 2:
      return (reader.readStringOrNull(offset)) as P;
    case 3:
      return (reader.readStringOrNull(offset)) as P;
    case 4:
      return (reader.readStringOrNull(offset)) as P;
    case 5:
      return (reader.readStringOrNull(offset)) as P;
    case 6:
      return (reader.readString(offset)) as P;
    case 7:
      return (reader.readDateTimeOrNull(offset)) as P;
    case 8:
      return (reader.readBool(offset)) as P;
    case 9:
      return (reader.readStringOrNull(offset)) as P;
    case 10:
      return (reader.readDateTime(offset)) as P;
    case 11:
      return (reader.readString(offset)) as P;
    case 12:
      return (reader.readStringOrNull(offset)) as P;
    case 13:
      return (reader.readString(offset)) as P;
    case 14:
      return (reader.readString(offset)) as P;
    case 15:
      return (reader.readString(offset)) as P;
    default:
      throw IsarError('Unknown property with id $propertyId');
  }
}

    on QueryBuilder<ActivityCollection, ActivityCollection, QSortThenBy> {
  QueryBuilder<ActivityCollection, ActivityCollection, QAfterSortBy>

int _campaignCollectionEstimateSize(
  CampaignCollection object,
  List<int> offsets,
  Map<Type, List<int>> allOffsets,
) {
  var bytesCount = offsets.last;
  {
    final value = object.analyticsJson;
    if (value != null) {
      bytesCount += 3 + value.length * 3;
    }
  }
  {
    final value = object.description;
    if (value != null) {
      bytesCount += 3 + value.length * 3;
    }
  }
  bytesCount += 3 + object.status.length * 3;
  bytesCount += 3 + object.targetSegments.length * 3;
  {
    for (var i = 0; i < object.targetSegments.length; i++) {
      final value = object.targetSegments[i];
      bytesCount += value.length * 3;
    }
  }
  bytesCount += 3 + object.title.length * 3;
  bytesCount += 3 + object.type.length * 3;
  bytesCount += 3 + object.uuid.length * 3;
  return bytesCount;
}

void _campaignCollectionSerialize(
  CampaignCollection object,
  IsarWriter writer,
  List<int> offsets,
  Map<Type, List<int>> allOffsets,
) {
  writer.writeDouble(offsets[0], object.actualCost);
  writer.writeString(offsets[1], object.analyticsJson);
  writer.writeLong(offsets[2], object.audienceCount);
  writer.writeDouble(offsets[3], object.budget);
  writer.writeLong(offsets[4], object.conversionCount);
  writer.writeString(offsets[5], object.description);
  writer.writeDateTime(offsets[6], object.endDate);
  writer.writeDouble(offsets[7], object.expectedRevenue);
  writer.writeDateTime(offsets[8], object.startDate);
  writer.writeString(offsets[9], object.status);
  writer.writeStringList(offsets[10], object.targetSegments);
  writer.writeString(offsets[11], object.title);
  writer.writeString(offsets[12], object.type);
  writer.writeString(offsets[13], object.uuid);
}

CampaignCollection _campaignCollectionDeserialize(
  Id id,
  IsarReader reader,
  List<int> offsets,
  Map<Type, List<int>> allOffsets,
) {
  final object = CampaignCollection();
  object.actualCost = reader.readDouble(offsets[0]);
  object.analyticsJson = reader.readStringOrNull(offsets[1]);
  object.audienceCount = reader.readLong(offsets[2]);
  object.budget = reader.readDouble(offsets[3]);
  object.conversionCount = reader.readLong(offsets[4]);
  object.description = reader.readStringOrNull(offsets[5]);
  object.endDate = reader.readDateTimeOrNull(offsets[6]);
  object.expectedRevenue = reader.readDouble(offsets[7]);
  object.id = id;
  object.startDate = reader.readDateTime(offsets[8]);
  object.status = reader.readString(offsets[9]);
  object.targetSegments = reader.readStringList(offsets[10]) ?? [];
  object.title = reader.readString(offsets[11]);
  object.type = reader.readString(offsets[12]);
  object.uuid = reader.readString(offsets[13]);
  return object;
}

P _campaignCollectionDeserializeProp<P>(
  IsarReader reader,
  int propertyId,
  int offset,
  Map<Type, List<int>> allOffsets,
) {
  switch (propertyId) {
    case 0:
      return (reader.readDouble(offset)) as P;
    case 1:
      return (reader.readStringOrNull(offset)) as P;
    case 2:
      return (reader.readLong(offset)) as P;
    case 3:
      return (reader.readDouble(offset)) as P;
    case 4:
      return (reader.readLong(offset)) as P;
    case 5:
      return (reader.readStringOrNull(offset)) as P;
    case 6:
      return (reader.readDateTimeOrNull(offset)) as P;
    case 7:
      return (reader.readDouble(offset)) as P;
    case 8:
      return (reader.readDateTime(offset)) as P;
    case 9:
      return (reader.readString(offset)) as P;
    case 10:
      return (reader.readStringList(offset) ?? []) as P;
    case 11:
      return (reader.readString(offset)) as P;
    case 12:
      return (reader.readString(offset)) as P;
    case 13:
      return (reader.readString(offset)) as P;
    default:
      throw IsarError('Unknown property with id $propertyId');
  }
}

extension CampaignCollectionQueryWhere
    on QueryBuilder<CampaignCollection, CampaignCollection, QWhereClause> {
  QueryBuilder<CampaignCollection, CampaignCollection, QAfterWhereClause>
      idEqualTo(Id id) {
    return QueryBuilder.apply(this, (query) {
      return query.addWhereClause(IdWhereClause.between(
        lower: id,
        upper: id,
      ));
    });
  }

  QueryBuilder<CampaignCollection, CampaignCollection, QAfterWhereClause>
      idNotEqualTo(Id id) {
    return QueryBuilder.apply(this, (query) {
      if (query.whereSort == Sort.asc) {
        return query
            .addWhereClause(
              IdWhereClause.lessThan(upper: id, includeUpper: false),
            )
            .addWhereClause(
              IdWhereClause.greaterThan(lower: id, includeLower: false),
            );
      } else {
        return query
            .addWhereClause(
              IdWhereClause.greaterThan(lower: id, includeLower: false),
            )
            .addWhereClause(
              IdWhereClause.lessThan(upper: id, includeUpper: false),
            );
      }
    });
  }

  QueryBuilder<CampaignCollection, CampaignCollection, QAfterWhereClause>
      idGreaterThan(Id id, {bool include = false}) {
    return QueryBuilder.apply(this, (query) {
      return query.addWhereClause(
        IdWhereClause.greaterThan(lower: id, includeLower: include),
      );
    });
  }

  QueryBuilder<CampaignCollection, CampaignCollection, QAfterWhereClause>
      idLessThan(Id id, {bool include = false}) {
    return QueryBuilder.apply(this, (query) {
      return query.addWhereClause(
        IdWhereClause.lessThan(upper: id, includeUpper: include),
      );
    });
  }

  QueryBuilder<CampaignCollection, CampaignCollection, QAfterWhereClause>
      idBetween(
    Id lowerId,
    Id upperId, {
    bool includeLower = true,
    bool includeUpper = true,
  }) {
    return QueryBuilder.apply(this, (query) {
      return query.addWhereClause(IdWhereClause.between(
        lower: lowerId,
        includeLower: includeLower,
        upper: upperId,
        includeUpper: includeUpper,
      ));
    });
  }

  QueryBuilder<CampaignCollection, CampaignCollection, QAfterWhereClause>
      uuidEqualTo(String uuid) {
    return QueryBuilder.apply(this, (query) {
      return query.addWhereClause(IndexWhereClause.equalTo(
        indexName: r'uuid',
        value: [uuid],
      ));
    });
  }

  QueryBuilder<CampaignCollection, CampaignCollection, QAfterWhereClause>
      uuidNotEqualTo(String uuid) {
    return QueryBuilder.apply(this, (query) {
      if (query.whereSort == Sort.asc) {
        return query
            .addWhereClause(IndexWhereClause.between(
              indexName: r'uuid',
              lower: [],
              upper: [uuid],
              includeUpper: false,
            ))
            .addWhereClause(IndexWhereClause.between(
              indexName: r'uuid',
              lower: [uuid],
              includeLower: false,
              upper: [],
            ));
      } else {
        return query
            .addWhereClause(IndexWhereClause.between(
              indexName: r'uuid',
              lower: [uuid],
              includeLower: false,
              upper: [],
            ))
            .addWhereClause(IndexWhereClause.between(
              indexName: r'uuid',
              lower: [],
              upper: [uuid],
              includeUpper: false,
            ));
      }
    });
  }

  QueryBuilder<CampaignCollection, CampaignCollection, QAfterWhereClause>
      titleEqualTo(String title) {
    return QueryBuilder.apply(this, (query) {
      return query.addWhereClause(IndexWhereClause.equalTo(
        indexName: r'title',
        value: [title],
      ));
    });
  }

  QueryBuilder<CampaignCollection, CampaignCollection, QAfterWhereClause>
      titleNotEqualTo(String title) {
    return QueryBuilder.apply(this, (query) {
      if (query.whereSort == Sort.asc) {
        return query
            .addWhereClause(IndexWhereClause.between(
              indexName: r'title',
              lower: [],
              upper: [title],
              includeUpper: false,
            ))
            .addWhereClause(IndexWhereClause.between(
              indexName: r'title',
              lower: [title],
              includeLower: false,
              upper: [],
            ));
      } else {
        return query
            .addWhereClause(IndexWhereClause.between(
              indexName: r'title',
              lower: [title],
              includeLower: false,
              upper: [],
            ))
            .addWhereClause(IndexWhereClause.between(
              indexName: r'title',
              lower: [],
              upper: [title],
              includeUpper: false,
            ));
      }
    });
  }

  QueryBuilder<CampaignCollection, CampaignCollection, QAfterWhereClause>
      startDateEqualTo(DateTime startDate) {
    return QueryBuilder.apply(this, (query) {
      return query.addWhereClause(IndexWhereClause.equalTo(
        indexName: r'startDate',
        value: [startDate],
      ));
    });
  }

  QueryBuilder<CampaignCollection, CampaignCollection, QAfterWhereClause>
      startDateNotEqualTo(DateTime startDate) {
    return QueryBuilder.apply(this, (query) {
      if (query.whereSort == Sort.asc) {
        return query
            .addWhereClause(IndexWhereClause.between(
              indexName: r'startDate',
              lower: [],
              upper: [startDate],
              includeUpper: false,
            ))
            .addWhereClause(IndexWhereClause.between(
              indexName: r'startDate',
              lower: [startDate],
              includeLower: false,
              upper: [],
            ));
      } else {
        return query
            .addWhereClause(IndexWhereClause.between(
              indexName: r'startDate',
              lower: [startDate],
              includeLower: false,
              upper: [],
            ))
            .addWhereClause(IndexWhereClause.between(
              indexName: r'startDate',
              lower: [],
              upper: [startDate],
              includeUpper: false,
            ));
      }
    });
  }

  QueryBuilder<CampaignCollection, CampaignCollection, QAfterWhereClause>
      startDateGreaterThan(
    DateTime startDate, {
    bool include = false,
  }) {
    return QueryBuilder.apply(this, (query) {
      return query.addWhereClause(IndexWhereClause.between(
        indexName: r'startDate',
        lower: [startDate],
        includeLower: include,
        upper: [],
      ));
    });
  }

  QueryBuilder<CampaignCollection, CampaignCollection, QAfterWhereClause>
      startDateLessThan(
    DateTime startDate, {
    bool include = false,
  }) {
    return QueryBuilder.apply(this, (query) {
      return query.addWhereClause(IndexWhereClause.between(
        indexName: r'startDate',
        lower: [],
        upper: [startDate],
        includeUpper: include,
      ));
    });
  }

  QueryBuilder<CampaignCollection, CampaignCollection, QAfterWhereClause>
      startDateBetween(
    DateTime lowerStartDate,
    DateTime upperStartDate, {
    bool includeLower = true,
    bool includeUpper = true,
  }) {
    return QueryBuilder.apply(this, (query) {
      return query.addWhereClause(IndexWhereClause.between(
        indexName: r'startDate',
        lower: [lowerStartDate],
        includeLower: includeLower,
        upper: [upperStartDate],
        includeUpper: includeUpper,
      ));
    });
  }
}

int _ticketCollectionEstimateSize(
  TicketCollection object,
  List<int> offsets,
  Map<Type, List<int>> allOffsets,
) {
  var bytesCount = offsets.last;
  {
    final value = object.assignedToId;
    if (value != null) {
      bytesCount += 3 + value.length * 3;
    }
  }
  bytesCount += 3 + object.category.length * 3;
  bytesCount += 3 + object.customerId.length * 3;
  {
    final value = object.description;
    if (value != null) {
      bytesCount += 3 + value.length * 3;
    }
  }
  bytesCount += 3 + object.priority.length * 3;
  bytesCount += 3 + object.resolutionNotes.length * 3;
  {
    for (var i = 0; i < object.resolutionNotes.length; i++) {
      final value = object.resolutionNotes[i];
      bytesCount += value.length * 3;
    }
  }
  bytesCount += 3 + object.status.length * 3;
  bytesCount += 3 + object.subject.length * 3;
  bytesCount += 3 + object.ticketNumber.length * 3;
  bytesCount += 3 + object.uuid.length * 3;
  return bytesCount;
}

void _ticketCollectionSerialize(
  TicketCollection object,
  IsarWriter writer,
  List<int> offsets,
  Map<Type, List<int>> allOffsets,
) {
  writer.writeString(offsets[0], object.assignedToId);
  writer.writeString(offsets[1], object.category);
  writer.writeDateTime(offsets[2], object.createdAt);
  writer.writeString(offsets[3], object.customerId);
  writer.writeString(offsets[4], object.description);
  writer.writeBool(offsets[5], object.isSlaBreached);
  writer.writeString(offsets[6], object.priority);
  writer.writeStringList(offsets[7], object.resolutionNotes);
  writer.writeDateTime(offsets[8], object.resolvedAt);
  writer.writeDateTime(offsets[9], object.slaDeadline);
  writer.writeString(offsets[10], object.status);
  writer.writeString(offsets[11], object.subject);
  writer.writeString(offsets[12], object.ticketNumber);
  writer.writeString(offsets[13], object.uuid);
}

TicketCollection _ticketCollectionDeserialize(
  Id id,
  IsarReader reader,
  List<int> offsets,
  Map<Type, List<int>> allOffsets,
) {
  final object = TicketCollection();
  object.assignedToId = reader.readStringOrNull(offsets[0]);
  object.category = reader.readString(offsets[1]);
  object.createdAt = reader.readDateTime(offsets[2]);
  object.customerId = reader.readString(offsets[3]);
  object.description = reader.readStringOrNull(offsets[4]);
  object.id = id;
  object.isSlaBreached = reader.readBool(offsets[5]);
  object.priority = reader.readString(offsets[6]);
  object.resolutionNotes = reader.readStringList(offsets[7]) ?? [];
  object.resolvedAt = reader.readDateTimeOrNull(offsets[8]);
  object.slaDeadline = reader.readDateTime(offsets[9]);
  object.status = reader.readString(offsets[10]);
  object.subject = reader.readString(offsets[11]);
  object.ticketNumber = reader.readString(offsets[12]);
  object.uuid = reader.readString(offsets[13]);
  return object;
}

    case 9:

    case 10:
      return (reader.readString(offset)) as P;
    case 11:
      return (reader.readString(offset)) as P;

extension TicketCollectionQueryWhereSort
    on QueryBuilder<TicketCollection, TicketCollection, QWhere> {
  QueryBuilder<TicketCollection, TicketCollection, QAfterWhere> anyId() {
    return QueryBuilder.apply(this, (query) {
      return query.addWhereClause(const IdWhereClause.any());
    });
  }
}

extension TicketCollectionQueryWhere
    on QueryBuilder<TicketCollection, TicketCollection, QWhereClause> {
  QueryBuilder<TicketCollection, TicketCollection, QAfterWhereClause> idEqualTo(
      Id id) {
    return QueryBuilder.apply(this, (query) {
      return query.addWhereClause(IdWhereClause.between(
        lower: id,
        upper: id,
      ));
    });
  }

  QueryBuilder<TicketCollection, TicketCollection, QAfterWhereClause>
      idNotEqualTo(Id id) {
    return QueryBuilder.apply(this, (query) {
      if (query.whereSort == Sort.asc) {
        return query
            .addWhereClause(
              IdWhereClause.lessThan(upper: id, includeUpper: false),
            )
            .addWhereClause(
              IdWhereClause.greaterThan(lower: id, includeLower: false),
            );
      } else {
        return query
            .addWhereClause(
              IdWhereClause.greaterThan(lower: id, includeLower: false),
            )
            .addWhereClause(
              IdWhereClause.lessThan(upper: id, includeUpper: false),
            );
      }
    });
  }

  QueryBuilder<TicketCollection, TicketCollection, QAfterWhereClause>
      idGreaterThan(Id id, {bool include = false}) {
    return QueryBuilder.apply(this, (query) {
      return query.addWhereClause(
        IdWhereClause.greaterThan(lower: id, includeLower: include),
      );
    });
  }

  QueryBuilder<TicketCollection, TicketCollection, QAfterWhereClause>
      idLessThan(Id id, {bool include = false}) {
    return QueryBuilder.apply(this, (query) {
      return query.addWhereClause(
        IdWhereClause.lessThan(upper: id, includeUpper: include),
      );
    });
  }

  QueryBuilder<TicketCollection, TicketCollection, QAfterWhereClause> idBetween(
    Id lowerId,
    Id upperId, {
    bool includeLower = true,
    bool includeUpper = true,
  }) {
    return QueryBuilder.apply(this, (query) {
      return query.addWhereClause(IdWhereClause.between(
        lower: lowerId,
        includeLower: includeLower,
        upper: upperId,
        includeUpper: includeUpper,
      ));
    });
  }

  QueryBuilder<TicketCollection, TicketCollection, QAfterWhereClause>
      uuidEqualTo(String uuid) {
    return QueryBuilder.apply(this, (query) {
      return query.addWhereClause(IndexWhereClause.equalTo(
        indexName: r'uuid',
        value: [uuid],
      ));
    });
  }

  QueryBuilder<TicketCollection, TicketCollection, QAfterWhereClause>
      uuidNotEqualTo(String uuid) {
    return QueryBuilder.apply(this, (query) {
      if (query.whereSort == Sort.asc) {
        return query
            .addWhereClause(IndexWhereClause.between(
              indexName: r'uuid',
              lower: [],
              upper: [uuid],
              includeUpper: false,
            ))
            .addWhereClause(IndexWhereClause.between(
              indexName: r'uuid',
              lower: [uuid],
              includeLower: false,
              upper: [],
            ));
      } else {
        return query
            .addWhereClause(IndexWhereClause.between(
              indexName: r'uuid',
              lower: [uuid],
              includeLower: false,
              upper: [],
            ))
            .addWhereClause(IndexWhereClause.between(
              indexName: r'uuid',
              lower: [],
              upper: [uuid],
              includeUpper: false,
            ));
      }
    });
  }

  QueryBuilder<TicketCollection, TicketCollection, QAfterWhereClause>
      ticketNumberEqualTo(String ticketNumber) {
    return QueryBuilder.apply(this, (query) {
      return query.addWhereClause(IndexWhereClause.equalTo(
        indexName: r'ticketNumber',
        value: [ticketNumber],
      ));
    });
  }

  QueryBuilder<TicketCollection, TicketCollection, QAfterWhereClause>
      ticketNumberNotEqualTo(String ticketNumber) {
    return QueryBuilder.apply(this, (query) {
      if (query.whereSort == Sort.asc) {
        return query
            .addWhereClause(IndexWhereClause.between(
              indexName: r'ticketNumber',
              lower: [],
              upper: [ticketNumber],
              includeUpper: false,
            ))
            .addWhereClause(IndexWhereClause.between(
              indexName: r'ticketNumber',
              lower: [ticketNumber],
              includeLower: false,
              upper: [],
            ));
      } else {
        return query
            .addWhereClause(IndexWhereClause.between(
              indexName: r'ticketNumber',
              lower: [ticketNumber],
              includeLower: false,
              upper: [],
            ))
            .addWhereClause(IndexWhereClause.between(
              indexName: r'ticketNumber',
              lower: [],
              upper: [ticketNumber],
              includeUpper: false,
            ));
      }
    });
  }

  QueryBuilder<TicketCollection, TicketCollection, QAfterWhereClause>
      customerIdEqualTo(String customerId) {
    return QueryBuilder.apply(this, (query) {
      return query.addWhereClause(IndexWhereClause.equalTo(
        indexName: r'customerId',
        value: [customerId],
      ));
    });
  }

  QueryBuilder<TicketCollection, TicketCollection, QAfterWhereClause>
      customerIdNotEqualTo(String customerId) {
    return QueryBuilder.apply(this, (query) {
      if (query.whereSort == Sort.asc) {
        return query
            .addWhereClause(IndexWhereClause.between(
              indexName: r'customerId',
              lower: [],
              upper: [customerId],

            .addWhereClause(IndexWhereClause.between(

      } else {

int _supplierCollectionEstimateSize(
  SupplierCollection object,
  List<int> offsets,
  Map<Type, List<int>> allOffsets,
) {
  var bytesCount = offsets.last;
  {
    final value = object.address;
    if (value != null) {
      bytesCount += 3 + value.length * 3;
    }
  }
  bytesCount += 3 + object.category.length * 3;
  {
    final value = object.city;
    if (value != null) {
      bytesCount += 3 + value.length * 3;
    }
  }
  bytesCount += 3 + object.currency.length * 3;
  bytesCount += 3 + object.email.length * 3;
  {
    final value = object.legalName;
    if (value != null) {
      bytesCount += 3 + value.length * 3;
    }
  }
  bytesCount += 3 + object.name.length * 3;
  bytesCount += 3 + object.phone.length * 3;
  bytesCount += 3 + object.supplierCode.length * 3;
  bytesCount += 3 + object.type.length * 3;
  bytesCount += 3 + object.uuid.length * 3;
  return bytesCount;
}

void _supplierCollectionSerialize(
  SupplierCollection object,
  IsarWriter writer,
  List<int> offsets,
  Map<Type, List<int>> allOffsets,
) {
  writer.writeString(offsets[0], object.address);
  writer.writeLong(offsets[1], object.averageLeadTime);
  writer.writeString(offsets[2], object.category);
  writer.writeString(offsets[3], object.city);
  writer.writeDateTime(offsets[4], object.createdAt);
  writer.writeDouble(offsets[5], object.creditLimit);
  writer.writeString(offsets[6], object.currency);
  writer.writeString(offsets[7], object.email);
  writer.writeBool(offsets[8], object.isDeleted);
  writer.writeBool(offsets[9], object.isPreferred);
  writer.writeString(offsets[10], object.legalName);
  writer.writeString(offsets[11], object.name);
  writer.writeString(offsets[12], object.phone);
  writer.writeDouble(offsets[13], object.ratingScore);
  writer.writeString(offsets[14], object.supplierCode);
  writer.writeString(offsets[15], object.type);
  writer.writeDateTime(offsets[16], object.updatedAt);
  writer.writeString(offsets[17], object.uuid);
}

SupplierCollection _supplierCollectionDeserialize(
  Id id,
  IsarReader reader,
  List<int> offsets,
  Map<Type, List<int>> allOffsets,
) {
  final object = SupplierCollection();
  object.address = reader.readStringOrNull(offsets[0]);
  object.averageLeadTime = reader.readLong(offsets[1]);
  object.category = reader.readString(offsets[2]);
  object.city = reader.readStringOrNull(offsets[3]);
  object.createdAt = reader.readDateTime(offsets[4]);
  object.creditLimit = reader.readDouble(offsets[5]);
  object.currency = reader.readString(offsets[6]);
  object.email = reader.readString(offsets[7]);
  object.id = id;
  object.isDeleted = reader.readBool(offsets[8]);
  object.isPreferred = reader.readBool(offsets[9]);
  object.legalName = reader.readStringOrNull(offsets[10]);
  object.name = reader.readString(offsets[11]);
  object.phone = reader.readString(offsets[12]);
  object.ratingScore = reader.readDouble(offsets[13]);
  object.supplierCode = reader.readString(offsets[14]);
  object.type = reader.readString(offsets[15]);
  object.updatedAt = reader.readDateTime(offsets[16]);
  object.uuid = reader.readString(offsets[17]);
  return object;
}

P _supplierCollectionDeserializeProp<P>(
  IsarReader reader,
  int propertyId,
  int offset,
  Map<Type, List<int>> allOffsets,
) {
  switch (propertyId) {
    case 0:
      return (reader.readStringOrNull(offset)) as P;
    case 1:
      return (reader.readLong(offset)) as P;
    case 2:
      return (reader.readString(offset)) as P;
    case 3:
      return (reader.readStringOrNull(offset)) as P;
    case 4:
      return (reader.readDateTime(offset)) as P;
    case 5:
      return (reader.readDouble(offset)) as P;
    case 6:
      return (reader.readString(offset)) as P;
    case 7:
      return (reader.readString(offset)) as P;
    case 8:
      return (reader.readBool(offset)) as P;
    case 9:
      return (reader.readBool(offset)) as P;
    case 10:
      return (reader.readStringOrNull(offset)) as P;
    case 11:
      return (reader.readString(offset)) as P;
    case 12:
      return (reader.readString(offset)) as P;
    case 13:
      return (reader.readDouble(offset)) as P;
    case 14:
      return (reader.readString(offset)) as P;
    case 15:
      return (reader.readString(offset)) as P;
    case 16:
      return (reader.readDateTime(offset)) as P;
    case 17:
      return (reader.readString(offset)) as P;
    default:
      throw IsarError('Unknown property with id $propertyId');
  }
}

    return QueryBuilder.apply(this, (query) {
      if (query.whereSort == Sort.asc) {
        return query
            .addWhereClause(
              IdWhereClause.lessThan(upper: id, includeUpper: false),

            .addWhereClause(
              IdWhereClause.greaterThan(lower: id, includeLower: false),

            .addWhereClause(
              IdWhereClause.greaterThan(lower: id, includeLower: false),

            .addWhereClause(
              IdWhereClause.lessThan(upper: id, includeUpper: false),
            );

      } else {
        return query
            .addWhereClause(IndexWhereClause.between(
              indexName: r'phone',
              lower: [phone],
              includeLower: false,
              upper: [],
            ))
            .addWhereClause(IndexWhereClause.between(
              indexName: r'phone',
              lower: [],
              upper: [phone],
              includeUpper: false,
            ));
      }
    });
  }

  QueryBuilder<SupplierCollection, SupplierCollection, QAfterWhereClause>
      isDeletedEqualTo(bool isDeleted) {
    return QueryBuilder.apply(this, (query) {
      return query.addWhereClause(IndexWhereClause.equalTo(
        indexName: r'isDeleted',
        value: [isDeleted],
      ));
    });
  }

  QueryBuilder<SupplierCollection, SupplierCollection, QAfterWhereClause>
      isDeletedNotEqualTo(bool isDeleted) {
    return QueryBuilder.apply(this, (query) {
      if (query.whereSort == Sort.asc) {
        return query
            .addWhereClause(IndexWhereClause.between(
              indexName: r'isDeleted',
              lower: [],
              upper: [isDeleted],
              includeUpper: false,
            ))
            .addWhereClause(IndexWhereClause.between(
              indexName: r'isDeleted',
              lower: [isDeleted],
              includeLower: false,
              upper: [],
            ));
      } else {
        return query
            .addWhereClause(IndexWhereClause.between(
              indexName: r'isDeleted',
              lower: [isDeleted],
              includeLower: false,
              upper: [],
            ))
            .addWhereClause(IndexWhereClause.between(
              indexName: r'isDeleted',
              lower: [],
              upper: [isDeleted],
              includeUpper: false,
            ));
      }
    });
  }
}

      return query.addFilterCondition(FilterCondition.lessThan(
        include: include,
        property: r'uuid',
        value: value,
        caseSensitive: caseSensitive,
      ));
    });
  }

  QueryBuilder<SupplierCollection, SupplierCollection, QAfterFilterCondition>
      uuidBetween(
    String lower,
    String upper, {
    bool includeLower = true,
    bool includeUpper = true,
    bool caseSensitive = true,
  }) {
    return QueryBuilder.apply(this, (query) {
      return query.addFilterCondition(FilterCondition.between(
        property: r'uuid',
        lower: lower,
        includeLower: includeLower,
        upper: upper,
        includeUpper: includeUpper,
        caseSensitive: caseSensitive,
      ));
    });
  }

  QueryBuilder<SupplierCollection, SupplierCollection, QAfterFilterCondition>
      uuidStartsWith(
    String value, {
    bool caseSensitive = true,
  }) {
    return QueryBuilder.apply(this, (query) {
      return query.addFilterCondition(FilterCondition.startsWith(
        property: r'uuid',
        value: value,
        caseSensitive: caseSensitive,
      ));
    });
  }

  QueryBuilder<SupplierCollection, SupplierCollection, QAfterFilterCondition>
      uuidEndsWith(
    String value, {
    bool caseSensitive = true,
  }) {
    return QueryBuilder.apply(this, (query) {
      return query.addFilterCondition(FilterCondition.endsWith(
        property: r'uuid',
        value: value,
        caseSensitive: caseSensitive,
      ));
    });
  }

  QueryBuilder<SupplierCollection, SupplierCollection, QAfterFilterCondition>
      uuidContains(String value, {bool caseSensitive = true}) {
    return QueryBuilder.apply(this, (query) {
      return query.addFilterCondition(FilterCondition.contains(
        property: r'uuid',
        value: value,
        caseSensitive: caseSensitive,
      ));
    });
  }

  QueryBuilder<SupplierCollection, SupplierCollection, QAfterFilterCondition>
      uuidMatches(String pattern, {bool caseSensitive = true}) {
    return QueryBuilder.apply(this, (query) {
      return query.addFilterCondition(FilterCondition.matches(
        property: r'uuid',
        wildcard: pattern,
        caseSensitive: caseSensitive,
      ));
    });
  }

  QueryBuilder<SupplierCollection, SupplierCollection, QAfterFilterCondition>
      uuidIsEmpty() {
    return QueryBuilder.apply(this, (query) {
      return query.addFilterCondition(FilterCondition.equalTo(
        property: r'uuid',
        value: '',
      ));
    });
  }

  QueryBuilder<SupplierCollection, SupplierCollection, QAfterFilterCondition>
      uuidIsNotEmpty() {
    return QueryBuilder.apply(this, (query) {
      return query.addFilterCondition(FilterCondition.greaterThan(
        property: r'uuid',
        value: '',
      ));
    });
  }

  },
  links: {},
  embeddedSchemas: {},
  getId: _accountCollectionGetId,
  getLinks: _accountCollectionGetLinks,
  attach: _accountCollectionAttach,
  version: '3.1.0+1',
);

int _accountCollectionEstimateSize(
  AccountCollection object,
  List<int> offsets,
  Map<Type, List<int>> allOffsets,
) {
  var bytesCount = offsets.last;
  bytesCount += 3 + object.category.length * 3;
  bytesCount += 3 + object.code.length * 3;
  bytesCount += 3 + object.currency.length * 3;
  bytesCount += 3 + object.name.length * 3;
  {
    final value = object.parentId;
    if (value != null) {
      bytesCount += 3 + value.length * 3;
    }
  }
  bytesCount += 3 + object.type.length * 3;
  bytesCount += 3 + object.uuid.length * 3;
  return bytesCount;
}

void _accountCollectionSerialize(
  AccountCollection object,
  IsarWriter writer,
  List<int> offsets,
  Map<Type, List<int>> allOffsets,
) {
  writer.writeString(offsets[0], object.category);
  writer.writeString(offsets[1], object.code);
  writer.writeString(offsets[2], object.currency);
  writer.writeDouble(offsets[3], object.currentBalance);
  writer.writeBool(offsets[4], object.isActive);
  writer.writeBool(offsets[5], object.isSystemAccount);
  writer.writeString(offsets[6], object.name);
  writer.writeString(offsets[7], object.parentId);
  writer.writeString(offsets[8], object.type);
  writer.writeString(offsets[9], object.uuid);
}

AccountCollection _accountCollectionDeserialize(
  Id id,
  IsarReader reader,
  List<int> offsets,
  Map<Type, List<int>> allOffsets,
) {
  final object = AccountCollection();
  object.category = reader.readString(offsets[0]);
  object.code = reader.readString(offsets[1]);
  object.currency = reader.readString(offsets[2]);
  object.currentBalance = reader.readDouble(offsets[3]);
  object.id = id;
  object.isActive = reader.readBool(offsets[4]);
  object.isSystemAccount = reader.readBool(offsets[5]);
  object.name = reader.readString(offsets[6]);
  object.parentId = reader.readStringOrNull(offsets[7]);
  object.type = reader.readString(offsets[8]);
  object.uuid = reader.readString(offsets[9]);
  return object;
}

P _accountCollectionDeserializeProp<P>(
  IsarReader reader,
  int propertyId,
  int offset,
  Map<Type, List<int>> allOffsets,
) {
  switch (propertyId) {
    case 0:
      return (reader.readString(offset)) as P;
    case 1:
      return (reader.readString(offset)) as P;
    case 2:
      return (reader.readString(offset)) as P;
    case 3:
      return (reader.readDouble(offset)) as P;
    case 4:
      return (reader.readBool(offset)) as P;
    case 5:
      return (reader.readBool(offset)) as P;
    case 6:
      return (reader.readString(offset)) as P;
    case 7:
      return (reader.readStringOrNull(offset)) as P;
    case 8:
      return (reader.readString(offset)) as P;
    case 9:
      return (reader.readString(offset)) as P;
    default:
      throw IsarError('Unknown property with id $propertyId');
  }
}

  return [];

    on QueryBuilder<AccountCollection, AccountCollection, QWhereClause> {
  QueryBuilder<AccountCollection, AccountCollection, QAfterWhereClause>
      idEqualTo(Id id) {
    return QueryBuilder.apply(this, (query) {
      return query.addWhereClause(IdWhereClause.between(
        lower: id,
        upper: id,
      ));
    });
  }

  QueryBuilder<AccountCollection, AccountCollection, QAfterWhereClause>
      idNotEqualTo(Id id) {
    return QueryBuilder.apply(this, (query) {
      if (query.whereSort == Sort.asc) {
        return query
            .addWhereClause(
              IdWhereClause.lessThan(upper: id, includeUpper: false),
            )
            .addWhereClause(
              IdWhereClause.greaterThan(lower: id, includeLower: false),
            );
      } else {
        return query
            .addWhereClause(
              IdWhereClause.greaterThan(lower: id, includeLower: false),
            )
            .addWhereClause(
              IdWhereClause.lessThan(upper: id, includeUpper: false),
            );
      }
    });
  }

int _journalEntryCollectionEstimateSize(
  JournalEntryCollection object,
  List<int> offsets,
  Map<Type, List<int>> allOffsets,
) {
  var bytesCount = offsets.last;
  bytesCount += 3 + object.description.length * 3;
  {
    final list = object.lines;
    if (list != null) {
      bytesCount += 3 + list.length * 3;
      {
        final offsets = allOffsets[JournalLineEmbedded]!;
        for (var i = 0; i < list.length; i++) {
          final value = list[i];
          bytesCount += JournalLineEmbeddedSchema.estimateSize(
              value, offsets, allOffsets);
        }
      }
    }
  }
  bytesCount += 3 + object.referenceNumber.length * 3;
  {
    final value = object.sourceDocumentId;
    if (value != null) {
      bytesCount += 3 + value.length * 3;
    }
  }
  bytesCount += 3 + object.sourceModule.length * 3;
  bytesCount += 3 + object.status.length * 3;
  bytesCount += 3 + object.uuid.length * 3;
  return bytesCount;
}

void _journalEntryCollectionSerialize(
  JournalEntryCollection object,
  IsarWriter writer,
  List<int> offsets,
  Map<Type, List<int>> allOffsets,
) {
  writer.writeDateTime(offsets[0], object.createdAt);
  writer.writeDateTime(offsets[1], object.date);
  writer.writeString(offsets[2], object.description);
  writer.writeObjectList<JournalLineEmbedded>(
    offsets[3],
    allOffsets,
    JournalLineEmbeddedSchema.serialize,
    object.lines,
  );
  writer.writeString(offsets[4], object.referenceNumber);
  writer.writeString(offsets[5], object.sourceDocumentId);
  writer.writeString(offsets[6], object.sourceModule);
  writer.writeString(offsets[7], object.status);
  writer.writeString(offsets[8], object.uuid);
}

JournalEntryCollection _journalEntryCollectionDeserialize(
  Id id,
  IsarReader reader,
  List<int> offsets,
  Map<Type, List<int>> allOffsets,
) {
  final object = JournalEntryCollection();
  object.createdAt = reader.readDateTime(offsets[0]);
  object.date = reader.readDateTime(offsets[1]);
  object.description = reader.readString(offsets[2]);
  object.id = id;
  object.lines = reader.readObjectList<JournalLineEmbedded>(
    offsets[3],
    JournalLineEmbeddedSchema.deserialize,
    allOffsets,
    JournalLineEmbedded(),
  );
  object.referenceNumber = reader.readString(offsets[4]);
  object.sourceDocumentId = reader.readStringOrNull(offsets[5]);
  object.sourceModule = reader.readString(offsets[6]);
  object.status = reader.readString(offsets[7]);
  object.uuid = reader.readString(offsets[8]);
  return object;
}

            ))
            .addWhereClause(IndexWhereClause.between(
              indexName: r'date',
              lower: [date],
              includeLower: false,
              upper: [],
            ));
      } else {
        return query
            .addWhereClause(IndexWhereClause.between(
              indexName: r'date',
              lower: [date],
              includeLower: false,
              upper: [],
            ))
            .addWhereClause(IndexWhereClause.between(
              indexName: r'date',
              lower: [],
              upper: [date],
              includeUpper: false,
            ));
      }
    });
  }

  QueryBuilder<JournalEntryCollection, JournalEntryCollection,

    return QueryBuilder.apply(this, (query) {
      if (query.whereSort == Sort.asc) {
        return query
            .addWhereClause(IndexWhereClause.between(
              indexName: r'status',
              lower: [],
              upper: [status],
              includeUpper: false,

            .addWhereClause(IndexWhereClause.between(

              upper: [status],

  BankAccountCollection object,

) {
  var bytesCount = offsets.last;
  bytesCount += 3 + object.accountNumber.length * 3;
  bytesCount += 3 + object.bankName.length * 3;
  bytesCount += 3 + object.branchName.length * 3;
  bytesCount += 3 + object.currency.length * 3;
  {
    final value = object.ifscCode;
    if (value != null) {
      bytesCount += 3 + value.length * 3;
    }
  }
  bytesCount += 3 + object.name.length * 3;
  {
    final value = object.swiftCode;
    if (value != null) {
      bytesCount += 3 + value.length * 3;
    }
  }
  bytesCount += 3 + object.type.length * 3;
  bytesCount += 3 + object.uuid.length * 3;
  return bytesCount;
}

) {

  writer.writeDouble(offsets[1], object.availableBalance);
  writer.writeString(offsets[2], object.bankName);
  writer.writeString(offsets[3], object.branchName);
  writer.writeString(offsets[4], object.currency);
  writer.writeDouble(offsets[5], object.currentBalance);
  writer.writeString(offsets[6], object.ifscCode);
  writer.writeBool(offsets[7], object.isActive);
  writer.writeString(offsets[8], object.name);
  writer.writeString(offsets[9], object.swiftCode);
  writer.writeString(offsets[10], object.type);
  writer.writeString(offsets[11], object.uuid);
}

  object.branchName = reader.readString(offsets[3]);
  object.currency = reader.readString(offsets[4]);
  object.currentBalance = reader.readDouble(offsets[5]);
  object.id = id;
  object.ifscCode = reader.readStringOrNull(offsets[6]);
  object.isActive = reader.readBool(offsets[7]);
  object.name = reader.readString(offsets[8]);
  object.swiftCode = reader.readStringOrNull(offsets[9]);
  object.type = reader.readString(offsets[10]);
  object.uuid = reader.readString(offsets[11]);
  return object;
}

P _bankAccountCollectionDeserializeProp<P>(
  IsarReader reader,
  int propertyId,
  int offset,
  Map<Type, List<int>> allOffsets,
) {
  switch (propertyId) {
    case 0:
      return (reader.readString(offset)) as P;
    case 1:
      return (reader.readDouble(offset)) as P;
    case 2:
      return (reader.readString(offset)) as P;
    case 3:
      return (reader.readString(offset)) as P;
    case 4:
      return (reader.readString(offset)) as P;
    case 5:
      return (reader.readDouble(offset)) as P;
    case 6:
      return (reader.readStringOrNull(offset)) as P;
    case 7:
      return (reader.readBool(offset)) as P;
    case 8:
      return (reader.readString(offset)) as P;
    case 9:
      return (reader.readStringOrNull(offset)) as P;
    case 10:
      return (reader.readString(offset)) as P;
    case 11:
      return (reader.readString(offset)) as P;
    default:
      throw IsarError('Unknown property with id $propertyId');
  }
}

        lower: id,
        upper: id,
      ));
    });
  }

  QueryBuilder<BankAccountCollection, BankAccountCollection, QAfterWhereClause>
      idNotEqualTo(Id id) {
    return QueryBuilder.apply(this, (query) {
      if (query.whereSort == Sort.asc) {
        return query
            .addWhereClause(
              IdWhereClause.lessThan(upper: id, includeUpper: false),
            )
            .addWhereClause(
              IdWhereClause.greaterThan(lower: id, includeLower: false),
            );
      } else {
        return query
            .addWhereClause(
              IdWhereClause.greaterThan(lower: id, includeLower: false),
            )
            .addWhereClause(
              IdWhereClause.lessThan(upper: id, includeUpper: false),
            );

int _bankTransactionCollectionEstimateSize(
  BankTransactionCollection object,
  List<int> offsets,
  Map<Type, List<int>> allOffsets,
) {
  var bytesCount = offsets.last;
  bytesCount += 3 + object.bankAccountId.length * 3;
  {
    final value = object.counterPartyName;
    if (value != null) {
      bytesCount += 3 + value.length * 3;
    }
  }
  bytesCount += 3 + object.description.length * 3;
  {
    final value = object.referenceNumber;
    if (value != null) {
      bytesCount += 3 + value.length * 3;
    }
  }
  bytesCount += 3 + object.status.length * 3;
  bytesCount += 3 + object.type.length * 3;
  bytesCount += 3 + object.uuid.length * 3;
  return bytesCount;
}

void _bankTransactionCollectionSerialize(
  BankTransactionCollection object,
  IsarWriter writer,
  List<int> offsets,
  Map<Type, List<int>> allOffsets,
) {
  writer.writeDouble(offsets[0], object.amount);
  writer.writeString(offsets[1], object.bankAccountId);
  writer.writeString(offsets[2], object.counterPartyName);
  writer.writeDateTime(offsets[3], object.date);
  writer.writeString(offsets[4], object.description);
  writer.writeString(offsets[5], object.referenceNumber);
  writer.writeString(offsets[6], object.status);
  writer.writeString(offsets[7], object.type);
  writer.writeString(offsets[8], object.uuid);
}

  Id id,
  IsarReader reader,

) {

  object.bankAccountId = reader.readString(offsets[1]);

  object.status = reader.readString(offsets[6]);
  object.type = reader.readString(offsets[7]);
  object.uuid = reader.readString(offsets[8]);
  return object;
}

extension BankTransactionCollectionQueryWhere on QueryBuilder<
    BankTransactionCollection, BankTransactionCollection, QWhereClause> {
  QueryBuilder<BankTransactionCollection, BankTransactionCollection,
      QAfterWhereClause> idEqualTo(Id id) {
    return QueryBuilder.apply(this, (query) {
      return query.addWhereClause(IdWhereClause.between(
        lower: id,
        upper: id,
      ));
    });
  }

  QueryBuilder<BankTransactionCollection, BankTransactionCollection,
      QAfterWhereClause> idNotEqualTo(Id id) {
    return QueryBuilder.apply(this, (query) {
      if (query.whereSort == Sort.asc) {
        return query
            .addWhereClause(
              IdWhereClause.lessThan(upper: id, includeUpper: false),
            )
            .addWhereClause(
              IdWhereClause.greaterThan(lower: id, includeLower: false),
            );
      } else {
        return query
            .addWhereClause(
              IdWhereClause.greaterThan(lower: id, includeLower: false),
            )
            .addWhereClause(
              IdWhereClause.lessThan(upper: id, includeUpper: false),
            );
      }
    });
  }

  QueryBuilder<BankTransactionCollection, BankTransactionCollection,
      QAfterWhereClause> idGreaterThan(Id id, {bool include = false}) {
    return QueryBuilder.apply(this, (query) {

      );

      return query.addWhereClause(
        IdWhereClause.lessThan(upper: id, includeUpper: include),

int _expenseCollectionEstimateSize(
  ExpenseCollection object,
  List<int> offsets,
  Map<Type, List<int>> allOffsets,
) {
  var bytesCount = offsets.last;
  bytesCount += 3 + object.category.length * 3;
  {
    final value = object.claimId;
    if (value != null) {
      bytesCount += 3 + value.length * 3;
    }
  }
  bytesCount += 3 + object.currency.length * 3;
  {
    final value = object.departmentId;
    if (value != null) {
      bytesCount += 3 + value.length * 3;
    }
  }
  bytesCount += 3 + object.description.length * 3;
  bytesCount += 3 + object.employeeId.length * 3;
  {
    final value = object.receiptUrl;
    if (value != null) {
      bytesCount += 3 + value.length * 3;
    }
  }
  bytesCount += 3 + object.status.length * 3;
  bytesCount += 3 + object.uuid.length * 3;
  return bytesCount;
}

void _expenseCollectionSerialize(
  ExpenseCollection object,
  IsarWriter writer,
  List<int> offsets,
  Map<Type, List<int>> allOffsets,
) {
  writer.writeDouble(offsets[0], object.amount);
  writer.writeString(offsets[1], object.category);
  writer.writeString(offsets[2], object.claimId);
  writer.writeString(offsets[3], object.currency);
  writer.writeDateTime(offsets[4], object.date);
  writer.writeString(offsets[5], object.departmentId);
  writer.writeString(offsets[6], object.description);
  writer.writeString(offsets[7], object.employeeId);
  writer.writeString(offsets[8], object.receiptUrl);
  writer.writeString(offsets[9], object.status);
  writer.writeDouble(offsets[10], object.taxAmount);
  writer.writeString(offsets[11], object.uuid);
}

ExpenseCollection _expenseCollectionDeserialize(
  Id id,
  IsarReader reader,
  List<int> offsets,
  Map<Type, List<int>> allOffsets,
) {
  final object = ExpenseCollection();
  object.amount = reader.readDouble(offsets[0]);
  object.category = reader.readString(offsets[1]);
  object.claimId = reader.readStringOrNull(offsets[2]);
  object.currency = reader.readString(offsets[3]);
  object.date = reader.readDateTime(offsets[4]);
  object.departmentId = reader.readStringOrNull(offsets[5]);
  object.description = reader.readString(offsets[6]);
  object.employeeId = reader.readString(offsets[7]);
  object.id = id;
  object.receiptUrl = reader.readStringOrNull(offsets[8]);
  object.status = reader.readString(offsets[9]);
  object.taxAmount = reader.readDouble(offsets[10]);
  object.uuid = reader.readString(offsets[11]);
  return object;
}

P _expenseCollectionDeserializeProp<P>(
  IsarReader reader,
  int propertyId,
  int offset,
  Map<Type, List<int>> allOffsets,
) {
  switch (propertyId) {
    case 0:
      return (reader.readDouble(offset)) as P;
    case 1:
      return (reader.readString(offset)) as P;
    case 2:
      return (reader.readStringOrNull(offset)) as P;
    case 3:
      return (reader.readString(offset)) as P;
    case 4:
      return (reader.readDateTime(offset)) as P;
    case 5:
      return (reader.readStringOrNull(offset)) as P;
    case 6:
      return (reader.readString(offset)) as P;
    case 7:
      return (reader.readString(offset)) as P;
    case 8:
      return (reader.readStringOrNull(offset)) as P;
    case 9:
      return (reader.readString(offset)) as P;
    case 10:
      return (reader.readDouble(offset)) as P;
    case 11:
      return (reader.readString(offset)) as P;
    default:
      throw IsarError('Unknown property with id $propertyId');
  }
}

  AccountsPayableCollection object,

  bytesCount += 3 + object.uuid.length * 3;

  return bytesCount;

      type: IsarType.string,
    ),
    r'paymentDate': PropertySchema(
      id: 3,
      name: r'paymentDate',
      type: IsarType.dateTime,
    ),
    r'uuid': PropertySchema(
      id: 4,
      name: r'uuid',
      type: IsarType.string,
    )
  },
  estimateSize: _paymentCollectionEstimateSize,
  serialize: _paymentCollectionSerialize,
  deserialize: _paymentCollectionDeserialize,
  deserializeProp: _paymentCollectionDeserializeProp,
  idName: r'id',
  indexes: {
    r'uuid': IndexSchema(
      id: 2134397340427724972,
      name: r'uuid',
      unique: true,
      replace: true,
      properties: [
        IndexPropertySchema(

      ],

    r'payableId': IndexSchema(

      name: r'payableId',
      unique: false,
      replace: false,
      properties: [
        IndexPropertySchema(
          name: r'payableId',

          caseSensitive: true,
        )
      ],
    )
  },
  links: {},
  embeddedSchemas: {},

int _paymentCollectionEstimateSize(
  PaymentCollection object,
  List<int> offsets,
  Map<Type, List<int>> allOffsets,
) {
  var bytesCount = offsets.last;
  bytesCount += 3 + object.method.length * 3;
  bytesCount += 3 + object.payableId.length * 3;
  bytesCount += 3 + object.uuid.length * 3;
  return bytesCount;
}

void _paymentCollectionSerialize(
  PaymentCollection object,
  IsarWriter writer,
  List<int> offsets,
  Map<Type, List<int>> allOffsets,
) {
  writer.writeDouble(offsets[0], object.amount);
  writer.writeString(offsets[1], object.method);
  writer.writeString(offsets[2], object.payableId);
  writer.writeDateTime(offsets[3], object.paymentDate);
  writer.writeString(offsets[4], object.uuid);
}

PaymentCollection _paymentCollectionDeserialize(
  Id id,
  IsarReader reader,
  List<int> offsets,
  Map<Type, List<int>> allOffsets,
) {
  final object = PaymentCollection();
  object.amount = reader.readDouble(offsets[0]);
  object.id = id;
  object.method = reader.readString(offsets[1]);
  object.payableId = reader.readString(offsets[2]);
  object.paymentDate = reader.readDateTime(offsets[3]);
  object.uuid = reader.readString(offsets[4]);
  return object;
}

P _paymentCollectionDeserializeProp<P>(
  IsarReader reader,
  int propertyId,
  int offset,
  Map<Type, List<int>> allOffsets,
) {
  switch (propertyId) {
    case 0:
      return (reader.readDouble(offset)) as P;
    case 1:
      return (reader.readString(offset)) as P;
    case 2:
      return (reader.readString(offset)) as P;
    case 3:
      return (reader.readDateTime(offset)) as P;
    case 4:
      return (reader.readString(offset)) as P;
    default:
      throw IsarError('Unknown property with id $propertyId');
  }
}

  return [];

extension PaymentCollectionByIndex on IsarCollection<PaymentCollection> {
  Future<PaymentCollection?> getByUuid(String uuid) {
    return getByIndex(r'uuid', [uuid]);
  }

  PaymentCollection? getByUuidSync(String uuid) {
    return getByIndexSync(r'uuid', [uuid]);
  }

  Future<bool> deleteByUuid(String uuid) {
    return deleteByIndex(r'uuid', [uuid]);
  }

  bool deleteByUuidSync(String uuid) {
    return deleteByIndexSync(r'uuid', [uuid]);
  }

  Future<List<PaymentCollection?>> getAllByUuid(List<String> uuidValues) {
    final values = uuidValues.map((e) => [e]).toList();
    return getAllByIndex(r'uuid', values);
  }

  List<PaymentCollection?> getAllByUuidSync(List<String> uuidValues) {
    final values = uuidValues.map((e) => [e]).toList();
    return getAllByIndexSync(r'uuid', values);
  }

  Future<int> deleteAllByUuid(List<String> uuidValues) {
    final values = uuidValues.map((e) => [e]).toList();
    return deleteAllByIndex(r'uuid', values);
  }

  int deleteAllByUuidSync(List<String> uuidValues) {
    final values = uuidValues.map((e) => [e]).toList();
    return deleteAllByIndexSync(r'uuid', values);
  }

  Future<Id> putByUuid(PaymentCollection object) {
    return putByIndex(r'uuid', object);
  }

  Id putByUuidSync(PaymentCollection object, {bool saveLinks = true}) {
    return putByIndexSync(r'uuid', object, saveLinks: saveLinks);
  }

  Future<List<Id>> putAllByUuid(List<PaymentCollection> objects) {
    return putAllByIndex(r'uuid', objects);
  }

  List<Id> putAllByUuidSync(List<PaymentCollection> objects,
      {bool saveLinks = true}) {

  }
}
