extension PaymentCollectionQueryWhere
    on QueryBuilder<PaymentCollection, PaymentCollection, QWhereClause> {
  QueryBuilder<PaymentCollection, PaymentCollection, QAfterWhereClause>
      idEqualTo(Id id) {
    return QueryBuilder.apply(this, (query) {
      return query.addWhereClause(IdWhereClause.between(
        lower: id,
        upper: id,
      ));
    });
  }

  QueryBuilder<PaymentCollection, PaymentCollection, QAfterWhereClause>
      idNotEqualTo(Id id) {
    return QueryBuilder.apply(this, (query) {
      if (query.whereSort == Sort.asc) {
        return query
            .addWhereClause(
              IdWhereClause.lessThan(upper: id, includeUpper: false),
            )
            .addWhereClause(
              IdWhereClause.greaterThan(lower: id, includeLower: false),
            );
      } else {
        return query
            .addWhereClause(
              IdWhereClause.greaterThan(lower: id, includeLower: false),
            )
            .addWhereClause(
              IdWhereClause.lessThan(upper: id, includeUpper: false),
            );
      }
    });
  }

  QueryBuilder<PaymentCollection, PaymentCollection, QAfterWhereClause>
      idGreaterThan(Id id, {bool include = false}) {
    return QueryBuilder.apply(this, (query) {
      return query.addWhereClause(
        IdWhereClause.greaterThan(lower: id, includeLower: include),
      );
    });
  }

  QueryBuilder<PaymentCollection, PaymentCollection, QAfterWhereClause>
      idLessThan(Id id, {bool include = false}) {
    return QueryBuilder.apply(this, (query) {
      return query.addWhereClause(
        IdWhereClause.lessThan(upper: id, includeUpper: include),
      );
    });
  }

  QueryBuilder<PaymentCollection, PaymentCollection, QAfterWhereClause>
      idBetween(
    Id lowerId,
    Id upperId, {
    bool includeLower = true,
    bool includeUpper = true,
  }) {
    return QueryBuilder.apply(this, (query) {
      return query.addWhereClause(IdWhereClause.between(
        lower: lowerId,
        includeLower: includeLower,
        upper: upperId,
        includeUpper: includeUpper,
      ));
    });
  }

  QueryBuilder<PaymentCollection, PaymentCollection, QAfterWhereClause>
      uuidEqualTo(String uuid) {
    return QueryBuilder.apply(this, (query) {
      return query.addWhereClause(IndexWhereClause.equalTo(
        indexName: r'uuid',
        value: [uuid],
      ));
    });
  }

  QueryBuilder<PaymentCollection, PaymentCollection, QAfterWhereClause>
      uuidNotEqualTo(String uuid) {
    return QueryBuilder.apply(this, (query) {
      if (query.whereSort == Sort.asc) {
        return query
            .addWhereClause(IndexWhereClause.between(
              indexName: r'uuid',
              lower: [],
              upper: [uuid],
              includeUpper: false,
            ))
            .addWhereClause(IndexWhereClause.between(
              indexName: r'uuid',
              lower: [uuid],
              includeLower: false,
              upper: [],
            ));
      } else {
        return query
            .addWhereClause(IndexWhereClause.between(
              indexName: r'uuid',
              lower: [uuid],
              includeLower: false,
              upper: [],
            ))
            .addWhereClause(IndexWhereClause.between(
              indexName: r'uuid',
              lower: [],
              upper: [uuid],
              includeUpper: false,
            ));
      }
    });
  }

  QueryBuilder<PaymentCollection, PaymentCollection, QAfterWhereClause>
      payableIdEqualTo(String payableId) {
    return QueryBuilder.apply(this, (query) {
      return query.addWhereClause(IndexWhereClause.equalTo(

      ));
    });
  }

  QueryBuilder<PaymentCollection, PaymentCollection, QAfterWhereClause>

    return QueryBuilder.apply(this, (query) {
      if (query.whereSort == Sort.asc) {
        return query

              upper: [payableId],

int _budgetCollectionEstimateSize(
  BudgetCollection object,
  List<int> offsets,
  Map<Type, List<int>> allOffsets,
) {
  var bytesCount = offsets.last;
  bytesCount += 3 + object.code.length * 3;
  {
    final value = object.costCenterId;
    if (value != null) {
      bytesCount += 3 + value.length * 3;
    }
  }
  {
    final value = object.departmentId;
    if (value != null) {
      bytesCount += 3 + value.length * 3;
    }
  }
  bytesCount += 3 + object.fiscalYearId.length * 3;
  bytesCount += 3 + object.name.length * 3;
  bytesCount += 3 + object.ownerId.length * 3;
  {
    final value = object.projectId;
    if (value != null) {
      bytesCount += 3 + value.length * 3;
    }
  }
  bytesCount += 3 + object.status.length * 3;
  bytesCount += 3 + object.uuid.length * 3;
  return bytesCount;
}

void _budgetCollectionSerialize(
  BudgetCollection object,
  IsarWriter writer,
  List<int> offsets,
  Map<Type, List<int>> allOffsets,
) {
  writer.writeDouble(offsets[0], object.allocatedAmount);
  writer.writeString(offsets[1], object.code);
  writer.writeString(offsets[2], object.costCenterId);
  writer.writeString(offsets[3], object.departmentId);
  writer.writeString(offsets[4], object.fiscalYearId);
  writer.writeString(offsets[5], object.name);
  writer.writeString(offsets[6], object.ownerId);
  writer.writeString(offsets[7], object.projectId);
  writer.writeString(offsets[8], object.status);
  writer.writeDouble(offsets[9], object.utilizedAmount);
  writer.writeString(offsets[10], object.uuid);
}

BudgetCollection _budgetCollectionDeserialize(
  Id id,
  IsarReader reader,
  List<int> offsets,
  Map<Type, List<int>> allOffsets,
) {
  final object = BudgetCollection();
  object.allocatedAmount = reader.readDouble(offsets[0]);
  object.code = reader.readString(offsets[1]);
  object.costCenterId = reader.readStringOrNull(offsets[2]);
  object.departmentId = reader.readStringOrNull(offsets[3]);
  object.fiscalYearId = reader.readString(offsets[4]);
  object.id = id;
  object.name = reader.readString(offsets[5]);
  object.ownerId = reader.readString(offsets[6]);
  object.projectId = reader.readStringOrNull(offsets[7]);
  object.status = reader.readString(offsets[8]);
  object.utilizedAmount = reader.readDouble(offsets[9]);
  object.uuid = reader.readString(offsets[10]);
  return object;
}

P _budgetCollectionDeserializeProp<P>(
  IsarReader reader,
  int propertyId,
  int offset,
  Map<Type, List<int>> allOffsets,
) {
  switch (propertyId) {
    case 0:
      return (reader.readDouble(offset)) as P;
    case 1:
      return (reader.readString(offset)) as P;
    case 2:
      return (reader.readStringOrNull(offset)) as P;
    case 3:
      return (reader.readStringOrNull(offset)) as P;
    case 4:
      return (reader.readString(offset)) as P;
    case 5:
      return (reader.readString(offset)) as P;
    case 6:
      return (reader.readString(offset)) as P;
    case 7:
      return (reader.readStringOrNull(offset)) as P;
    case 8:
      return (reader.readString(offset)) as P;
    case 9:
      return (reader.readDouble(offset)) as P;
    case 10:
      return (reader.readString(offset)) as P;
    default:
      throw IsarError('Unknown property with id $propertyId');
  }
}

    return QueryBuilder.apply(this, (query) {
      if (query.whereSort == Sort.asc) {
        return query
            .addWhereClause(
              IdWhereClause.lessThan(upper: id, includeUpper: false),
            )
            .addWhereClause(
              IdWhereClause.greaterThan(lower: id, includeLower: false),
            );
      } else {
        return query
            .addWhereClause(
              IdWhereClause.greaterThan(lower: id, includeLower: false),
            )
            .addWhereClause(
              IdWhereClause.lessThan(upper: id, includeUpper: false),
            );
      }
    });

int _costCenterCollectionEstimateSize(
  CostCenterCollection object,
  List<int> offsets,
  Map<Type, List<int>> allOffsets,
) {
  var bytesCount = offsets.last;
  bytesCount += 3 + object.code.length * 3;
  bytesCount += 3 + object.managerId.length * 3;
  bytesCount += 3 + object.name.length * 3;
  {
    final value = object.parentId;
    if (value != null) {
      bytesCount += 3 + value.length * 3;
    }
  }
  bytesCount += 3 + object.type.length * 3;
  bytesCount += 3 + object.uuid.length * 3;
  return bytesCount;
}

int _fixedAssetCollectionEstimateSize(
  FixedAssetCollection object,
  List<int> offsets,
  Map<Type, List<int>> allOffsets,
) {
  var bytesCount = offsets.last;
  bytesCount += 3 + object.assetCode.length * 3;
  bytesCount += 3 + object.categoryId.length * 3;
  {
    final value = object.custodianId;
    if (value != null) {
      bytesCount += 3 + value.length * 3;
    }
  }
  bytesCount += 3 + object.depreciationMethod.length * 3;
  bytesCount += 3 + object.groupId.length * 3;
  {
    final value = object.insurancePolicyNumber;
    if (value != null) {
      bytesCount += 3 + value.length * 3;
    }
  }
  {
    final value = object.locationId;
    if (value != null) {
      bytesCount += 3 + value.length * 3;
    }
  }
  bytesCount += 3 + object.name.length * 3;
  bytesCount += 3 + object.status.length * 3;
  bytesCount += 3 + object.uuid.length * 3;
  return bytesCount;
}

void _fixedAssetCollectionSerialize(
  FixedAssetCollection object,
  IsarWriter writer,
  List<int> offsets,
  Map<Type, List<int>> allOffsets,
) {
  writer.writeDateTime(offsets[0], object.acquisitionDate);
  writer.writeString(offsets[1], object.assetCode);
  writer.writeDateTime(offsets[2], object.capitalizationDate);
  writer.writeString(offsets[3], object.categoryId);
  writer.writeDouble(offsets[4], object.currentBookValue);
  writer.writeString(offsets[5], object.custodianId);
  writer.writeString(offsets[6], object.depreciationMethod);
  writer.writeString(offsets[7], object.groupId);
  writer.writeDateTime(offsets[8], object.insuranceExpiry);
  writer.writeString(offsets[9], object.insurancePolicyNumber);
  writer.writeBool(offsets[10], object.isCapitalized);
  writer.writeString(offsets[11], object.locationId);
  writer.writeString(offsets[12], object.name);
  writer.writeDouble(offsets[13], object.purchaseValue);
  writer.writeDouble(offsets[14], object.residualValue);
  writer.writeString(offsets[15], object.status);
  writer.writeLong(offsets[16], object.usefulLifeMonths);
  writer.writeString(offsets[17], object.uuid);
  writer.writeDateTime(offsets[18], object.warrantyExpiry);
}

FixedAssetCollection _fixedAssetCollectionDeserialize(
  Id id,
  IsarReader reader,
  List<int> offsets,
  Map<Type, List<int>> allOffsets,
) {
  final object = FixedAssetCollection();
  object.acquisitionDate = reader.readDateTime(offsets[0]);
  object.assetCode = reader.readString(offsets[1]);
  object.capitalizationDate = reader.readDateTimeOrNull(offsets[2]);
  object.categoryId = reader.readString(offsets[3]);
  object.currentBookValue = reader.readDouble(offsets[4]);
  object.custodianId = reader.readStringOrNull(offsets[5]);
  object.depreciationMethod = reader.readString(offsets[6]);
  object.groupId = reader.readString(offsets[7]);
  object.id = id;
  object.insuranceExpiry = reader.readDateTimeOrNull(offsets[8]);
  object.insurancePolicyNumber = reader.readStringOrNull(offsets[9]);
  object.isCapitalized = reader.readBool(offsets[10]);
  object.locationId = reader.readStringOrNull(offsets[11]);
  object.name = reader.readString(offsets[12]);
  object.purchaseValue = reader.readDouble(offsets[13]);
  object.residualValue = reader.readDouble(offsets[14]);
  object.status = reader.readString(offsets[15]);
  object.usefulLifeMonths = reader.readLong(offsets[16]);
  object.uuid = reader.readString(offsets[17]);
  object.warrantyExpiry = reader.readDateTimeOrNull(offsets[18]);
  return object;
}

  }) {
    return QueryBuilder.apply(this, (query) {
      return query.addWhereClause(IndexWhereClause.between(
        indexName: r'acquisitionDate',
        lower: [],
        upper: [acquisitionDate],
        includeUpper: include,
      ));
    });
  }

  QueryBuilder<FixedAssetCollection, FixedAssetCollection, QAfterWhereClause>
      acquisitionDateBetween(
    DateTime lowerAcquisitionDate,
    DateTime upperAcquisitionDate, {
    bool includeLower = true,
    bool includeUpper = true,
  }) {
    return QueryBuilder.apply(this, (query) {
      return query.addWhereClause(IndexWhereClause.between(
        indexName: r'acquisitionDate',
        lower: [lowerAcquisitionDate],
        includeLower: includeLower,
        upper: [upperAcquisitionDate],
        includeUpper: includeUpper,
      ));
    });
  }

  QueryBuilder<FixedAssetCollection, FixedAssetCollection, QAfterWhereClause>
      statusEqualTo(String status) {
    return QueryBuilder.apply(this, (query) {
      return query.addWhereClause(IndexWhereClause.equalTo(
        indexName: r'status',
        value: [status],
      ));
    });
  }

  QueryBuilder<FixedAssetCollection, FixedAssetCollection, QAfterWhereClause>
      statusNotEqualTo(String status) {
    return QueryBuilder.apply(this, (query) {
      if (query.whereSort == Sort.asc) {
        return query
            .addWhereClause(IndexWhereClause.between(
              indexName: r'status',
              lower: [],
              upper: [status],
              includeUpper: false,
            ))
            .addWhereClause(IndexWhereClause.between(
              indexName: r'status',
              lower: [status],
              includeLower: false,
              upper: [],
            ));
      } else {
        return query
            .addWhereClause(IndexWhereClause.between(
              indexName: r'status',
              lower: [status],
              includeLower: false,
              upper: [],
            ))
            .addWhereClause(IndexWhereClause.between(
              indexName: r'status',
              lower: [],
              upper: [status],
              includeUpper: false,
            ));
      }
    });
  }
}

int _taxRuleCollectionEstimateSize(
  TaxRuleCollection object,
  List<int> offsets,
  Map<Type, List<int>> allOffsets,
) {
  var bytesCount = offsets.last;
  bytesCount += 3 + object.category.length * 3;
  bytesCount += 3 + object.code.length * 3;
  bytesCount += 3 + object.country.length * 3;
  bytesCount += 3 + object.name.length * 3;
  {
    final value = object.state;
    if (value != null) {
      bytesCount += 3 + value.length * 3;
    }
  }
  bytesCount += 3 + object.type.length * 3;
  bytesCount += 3 + object.uuid.length * 3;
  return bytesCount;
}

int _taxReturnCollectionEstimateSize(
  TaxReturnCollection object,
  List<int> offsets,
  Map<Type, List<int>> allOffsets,
) {
  var bytesCount = offsets.last;
  {
    final value = object.filingReference;
    if (value != null) {
      bytesCount += 3 + value.length * 3;
    }
  }
  bytesCount += 3 + object.periodId.length * 3;
  bytesCount += 3 + object.status.length * 3;
  bytesCount += 3 + object.type.length * 3;
  bytesCount += 3 + object.uuid.length * 3;
  return bytesCount;
}

void _taxReturnCollectionSerialize(
  TaxReturnCollection object,
  IsarWriter writer,
  List<int> offsets,
  Map<Type, List<int>> allOffsets,
) {
  writer.writeDateTime(offsets[0], object.filingDate);
  writer.writeString(offsets[1], object.filingReference);
  writer.writeDouble(offsets[2], object.inputTaxCredit);
  writer.writeString(offsets[3], object.periodId);
  writer.writeString(offsets[4], object.status);
  writer.writeDouble(offsets[5], object.totalTaxAmount);
  writer.writeDouble(offsets[6], object.totalTaxableValue);
  writer.writeString(offsets[7], object.type);
  writer.writeString(offsets[8], object.uuid);
}

TaxReturnCollection _taxReturnCollectionDeserialize(
  Id id,
  IsarReader reader,
  List<int> offsets,
  Map<Type, List<int>> allOffsets,
) {
  final object = TaxReturnCollection();
  object.filingDate = reader.readDateTime(offsets[0]);
  object.filingReference = reader.readStringOrNull(offsets[1]);
  object.id = id;
  object.inputTaxCredit = reader.readDouble(offsets[2]);
  object.periodId = reader.readString(offsets[3]);
  object.status = reader.readString(offsets[4]);
  object.totalTaxAmount = reader.readDouble(offsets[5]);
  object.totalTaxableValue = reader.readDouble(offsets[6]);
  object.type = reader.readString(offsets[7]);
  object.uuid = reader.readString(offsets[8]);
  return object;
}

    return putByIndexSync(r'uuid', object, saveLinks: saveLinks);
  }

  Future<List<Id>> putAllByUuid(List<TaxReturnCollection> objects) {
    return putAllByIndex(r'uuid', objects);
  }

  List<Id> putAllByUuidSync(List<TaxReturnCollection> objects,
      {bool saveLinks = true}) {
    return putAllByIndexSync(r'uuid', objects, saveLinks: saveLinks);
  }

extension TaxReturnCollectionQueryWhereSort
    on QueryBuilder<TaxReturnCollection, TaxReturnCollection, QWhere> {
  QueryBuilder<TaxReturnCollection, TaxReturnCollection, QAfterWhere> anyId() {
    return QueryBuilder.apply(this, (query) {
      return query.addWhereClause(const IdWhereClause.any());
    });
  }
}

extension TaxReturnCollectionQueryWhere
    on QueryBuilder<TaxReturnCollection, TaxReturnCollection, QWhereClause> {
  QueryBuilder<TaxReturnCollection, TaxReturnCollection, QAfterWhereClause>
      idEqualTo(Id id) {
    return QueryBuilder.apply(this, (query) {
      return query.addWhereClause(IdWhereClause.between(
        lower: id,
        upper: id,
      ));
    });
  }

  QueryBuilder<TaxReturnCollection, TaxReturnCollection, QAfterWhereClause>
      idNotEqualTo(Id id) {
    return QueryBuilder.apply(this, (query) {
      if (query.whereSort == Sort.asc) {
        return query
            .addWhereClause(
              IdWhereClause.lessThan(upper: id, includeUpper: false),
            )
            .addWhereClause(
              IdWhereClause.greaterThan(lower: id, includeLower: false),
            );
      } else {
        return query
            .addWhereClause(
              IdWhereClause.greaterThan(lower: id, includeLower: false),
            )
            .addWhereClause(
              IdWhereClause.lessThan(upper: id, includeUpper: false),
            );
      }
    });
  }

  QueryBuilder<TaxReturnCollection, TaxReturnCollection, QAfterWhereClause>
      idGreaterThan(Id id, {bool include = false}) {
    return QueryBuilder.apply(this, (query) {
      return query.addWhereClause(
        IdWhereClause.greaterThan(lower: id, includeLower: include),
      );
    });
  }

  QueryBuilder<TaxReturnCollection, TaxReturnCollection, QAfterWhereClause>
      idLessThan(Id id, {bool include = false}) {
    return QueryBuilder.apply(this, (query) {
      return query.addWhereClause(
        IdWhereClause.lessThan(upper: id, includeUpper: include),
      );
    });
  }

  QueryBuilder<TaxReturnCollection, TaxReturnCollection, QAfterWhereClause>
      idBetween(
    Id lowerId,
    Id upperId, {
    bool includeLower = true,
    bool includeUpper = true,
  }) {
    return QueryBuilder.apply(this, (query) {
      return query.addWhereClause(IdWhereClause.between(
        lower: lowerId,
        includeLower: includeLower,
        upper: upperId,
        includeUpper: includeUpper,
      ));
    });
  }

  QueryBuilder<TaxReturnCollection, TaxReturnCollection, QAfterWhereClause>
      uuidEqualTo(String uuid) {
    return QueryBuilder.apply(this, (query) {
      return query.addWhereClause(IndexWhereClause.equalTo(
        indexName: r'uuid',
        value: [uuid],
      ));
    });
  }

  QueryBuilder<TaxReturnCollection, TaxReturnCollection, QAfterWhereClause>
      uuidNotEqualTo(String uuid) {
    return QueryBuilder.apply(this, (query) {
      if (query.whereSort == Sort.asc) {
        return query
            .addWhereClause(IndexWhereClause.between(
              indexName: r'uuid',
              lower: [],
              upper: [uuid],
              includeUpper: false,
            ))
            .addWhereClause(IndexWhereClause.between(
              indexName: r'uuid',
              lower: [uuid],
              includeLower: false,
              upper: [],
            ));
      } else {
        return query
            .addWhereClause(IndexWhereClause.between(
              indexName: r'uuid',
              lower: [uuid],
              includeLower: false,
              upper: [],
            ))
            .addWhereClause(IndexWhereClause.between(
              indexName: r'uuid',
              lower: [],
              upper: [uuid],
              includeUpper: false,
            ));
      }
    });
  }

  QueryBuilder<TaxReturnCollection, TaxReturnCollection, QAfterWhereClause>
      periodIdEqualTo(String periodId) {
    return QueryBuilder.apply(this, (query) {
      return query.addWhereClause(IndexWhereClause.equalTo(
        indexName: r'periodId',
        value: [periodId],
      ));
    });
  }

  QueryBuilder<TaxReturnCollection, TaxReturnCollection, QAfterWhereClause>
      periodIdNotEqualTo(String periodId) {
    return QueryBuilder.apply(this, (query) {
      if (query.whereSort == Sort.asc) {
        return query
            .addWhereClause(IndexWhereClause.between(
              indexName: r'periodId',
              lower: [],
              upper: [periodId],
              includeUpper: false,
            ))
            .addWhereClause(IndexWhereClause.between(
              indexName: r'periodId',
              lower: [periodId],
              includeLower: false,
              upper: [],
            ));
      } else {
        return query
            .addWhereClause(IndexWhereClause.between(
              indexName: r'periodId',
              lower: [periodId],
              includeLower: false,
              upper: [],
            ))
            .addWhereClause(IndexWhereClause.between(
              indexName: r'periodId',
              lower: [],
              upper: [periodId],
              includeUpper: false,
            ));
      }
    });
  }
}

  ClosingTaskCollection object,

  var bytesCount = offsets.last;

      bytesCount += 3 + value.length * 3;

  }
  bytesCount += 3 + object.category.length * 3;
  bytesCount += 3 + object.description.length * 3;
  bytesCount += 3 + object.periodId.length * 3;
  bytesCount += 3 + object.status.length * 3;
  bytesCount += 3 + object.title.length * 3;
  bytesCount += 3 + object.uuid.length * 3;
  return bytesCount;
}

  int propertyId,
  int offset,
  Map<Type, List<int>> allOffsets,
) {
  switch (propertyId) {
    case 0:
      return (reader.readStringOrNull(offset)) as P;
    case 1:
      return (reader.readString(offset)) as P;
    case 2:
      return (reader.readDateTimeOrNull(offset)) as P;
    case 3:
      return (reader.readString(offset)) as P;
    case 4:
      return (reader.readBool(offset)) as P;
    case 5:
      return (reader.readString(offset)) as P;
    case 6:
      return (reader.readString(offset)) as P;
    case 7:
      return (reader.readString(offset)) as P;
    case 8:
      return (reader.readString(offset)) as P;
    default:
      throw IsarError('Unknown property with id $propertyId');
  }

    return deleteByIndex(r'uuid', [uuid]);

    return deleteByIndexSync(r'uuid', [uuid]);

    final values = uuidValues.map((e) => [e]).toList();

    final values = uuidValues.map((e) => [e]).toList();
    return getAllByIndexSync(r'uuid', values);

    final values = uuidValues.map((e) => [e]).toList();
    return deleteAllByIndex(r'uuid', values);
  }

  int deleteAllByUuidSync(List<String> uuidValues) {
    final values = uuidValues.map((e) => [e]).toList();
    return deleteAllByIndexSync(r'uuid', values);
  }

  Future<Id> putByUuid(ClosingTaskCollection object) {
    return putByIndex(r'uuid', object);

extension ClosingTaskCollectionQueryWhere on QueryBuilder<ClosingTaskCollection,
    ClosingTaskCollection, QWhereClause> {
  QueryBuilder<ClosingTaskCollection, ClosingTaskCollection, QAfterWhereClause>
      idEqualTo(Id id) {
    return QueryBuilder.apply(this, (query) {
      return query.addWhereClause(IdWhereClause.between(
        lower: id,
        upper: id,
      ));
    });
  }

  QueryBuilder<ClosingTaskCollection, ClosingTaskCollection, QAfterWhereClause>
      idNotEqualTo(Id id) {
    return QueryBuilder.apply(this, (query) {
      if (query.whereSort == Sort.asc) {
        return query
            .addWhereClause(
              IdWhereClause.lessThan(upper: id, includeUpper: false),
            )
            .addWhereClause(
              IdWhereClause.greaterThan(lower: id, includeLower: false),
            );
      } else {
        return query
            .addWhereClause(
              IdWhereClause.greaterThan(lower: id, includeLower: false),
            )
            .addWhereClause(
              IdWhereClause.lessThan(upper: id, includeUpper: false),
            );
      }
    });
  }

  QueryBuilder<ClosingTaskCollection, ClosingTaskCollection, QAfterWhereClause>
      idGreaterThan(Id id, {bool include = false}) {
    return QueryBuilder.apply(this, (query) {
      return query.addWhereClause(
        IdWhereClause.greaterThan(lower: id, includeLower: include),
      );
    });
  }

  QueryBuilder<ClosingTaskCollection, ClosingTaskCollection, QAfterWhereClause>
      idLessThan(Id id, {bool include = false}) {
    return QueryBuilder.apply(this, (query) {
      return query.addWhereClause(
        IdWhereClause.lessThan(upper: id, includeUpper: include),
      );
    });
  }

  QueryBuilder<ClosingTaskCollection, ClosingTaskCollection, QAfterWhereClause>
      idBetween(
    Id lowerId,
    Id upperId, {
    bool includeLower = true,
    bool includeUpper = true,
  }) {
    return QueryBuilder.apply(this, (query) {
      return query.addWhereClause(IdWhereClause.between(
        lower: lowerId,
        includeLower: includeLower,
        upper: upperId,
        includeUpper: includeUpper,
      ));
    });
  }

  QueryBuilder<ClosingTaskCollection, ClosingTaskCollection, QAfterWhereClause>
      uuidEqualTo(String uuid) {
    return QueryBuilder.apply(this, (query) {
      return query.addWhereClause(IndexWhereClause.equalTo(
        indexName: r'uuid',
        value: [uuid],
      ));
    });
  }

  QueryBuilder<ClosingTaskCollection, ClosingTaskCollection, QAfterWhereClause>
      uuidNotEqualTo(String uuid) {
    return QueryBuilder.apply(this, (query) {
      if (query.whereSort == Sort.asc) {
        return query
            .addWhereClause(IndexWhereClause.between(
              indexName: r'uuid',
              lower: [],
              upper: [uuid],
              includeUpper: false,
            ))
            .addWhereClause(IndexWhereClause.between(
              indexName: r'uuid',
              lower: [uuid],
              includeLower: false,
              upper: [],
            ));
      } else {
        return query
            .addWhereClause(IndexWhereClause.between(
              indexName: r'uuid',
              lower: [uuid],
              includeLower: false,
              upper: [],
            ))
            .addWhereClause(IndexWhereClause.between(
              indexName: r'uuid',
              lower: [],
              upper: [uuid],
              includeUpper: false,
            ));
      }
    });
  }

  QueryBuilder<ClosingTaskCollection, ClosingTaskCollection, QAfterWhereClause>
      periodIdEqualTo(String periodId) {
    return QueryBuilder.apply(this, (query) {
      return query.addWhereClause(IndexWhereClause.equalTo(
        indexName: r'periodId',
        value: [periodId],
      ));
    });
  }

  QueryBuilder<ClosingTaskCollection, ClosingTaskCollection, QAfterWhereClause>
      periodIdNotEqualTo(String periodId) {
    return QueryBuilder.apply(this, (query) {
      if (query.whereSort == Sort.asc) {
        return query
            .addWhereClause(IndexWhereClause.between(
              indexName: r'periodId',
              lower: [],
              upper: [periodId],
              includeUpper: false,
            ))
            .addWhereClause(IndexWhereClause.between(
              indexName: r'periodId',
              lower: [periodId],
              includeLower: false,
              upper: [],
            ));
      } else {
        return query
            .addWhereClause(IndexWhereClause.between(

              lower: [periodId],
              includeLower: false,

              IdWhereClause.lessThan(upper: id, includeUpper: false),

class RestaurantFloorCollection {

@collection
class RestaurantTableCollection {
  Id id = Isar.autoIncrement;

  @Index(unique: true, replace: true)
  late String uuid;

  @Index()
  late String tableNumber;

  @Index()
  late String floorId;

  late String section;
  late int capacity;
  late int currentGuestCount;

  @Index()
  late String status; // empty, reserved, seated, ordered, billed, cleaning

  String? activeOrderId;

  late double posY;
  late String shape; // round, square, rectangle
  
  bool isMergeable = true;
}

@collection
class KotCollection {
  Id id = Isar.autoIncrement;

  @Index(unique: true, replace: true)
  late String uuid;

  @Index()
  late String orderId;

  String? tableId;
  late String orderType; // dineIn, takeaway, delivery

  late List<KotItemEmbedded> items;

  @Index()
  late String station; // kitchen, bar, tandoor, etc

  @Index()
  late String status; // new, accepted, preparing, ready, served, cancelled

  late DateTime createdAt;
  late int priority; // 0: Normal, 1: High, 2: VIP
  String? notes;
}

@embedded
class KotItemEmbedded {
  late String productId;
  late String name;
  late double quantity;
  String? modifiers;
  String? notes;
}

int _kotCollectionEstimateSize(
  KotCollection object,
  List<int> offsets,
  Map<Type, List<int>> allOffsets,
) {
  var bytesCount = offsets.last;
  bytesCount += 3 + object.items.length * 3;
  {
    final offsets = allOffsets[KotItemEmbedded]!;
    for (var i = 0; i < object.items.length; i++) {
      final value = object.items[i];
      bytesCount +=
          KotItemEmbeddedSchema.estimateSize(value, offsets, allOffsets);
    }
  }
  {
    final value = object.notes;
    if (value != null) {
      bytesCount += 3 + value.length * 3;
    }
  }
  bytesCount += 3 + object.orderId.length * 3;
  bytesCount += 3 + object.orderType.length * 3;
  bytesCount += 3 + object.station.length * 3;
  bytesCount += 3 + object.status.length * 3;
  {
    final value = object.tableId;
    if (value != null) {
      bytesCount += 3 + value.length * 3;
    }
  }
  bytesCount += 3 + object.uuid.length * 3;
  return bytesCount;
}

void _kotCollectionSerialize(
  KotCollection object,
  IsarWriter writer,
  List<int> offsets,
  Map<Type, List<int>> allOffsets,
) {
  writer.writeDateTime(offsets[0], object.createdAt);
  writer.writeObjectList<KotItemEmbedded>(
    offsets[1],
    allOffsets,
    KotItemEmbeddedSchema.serialize,
    object.items,
  );
  writer.writeString(offsets[2], object.notes);
  writer.writeString(offsets[3], object.orderId);
  writer.writeString(offsets[4], object.orderType);
  writer.writeLong(offsets[5], object.priority);
  writer.writeString(offsets[6], object.station);
  writer.writeString(offsets[7], object.status);
  writer.writeString(offsets[8], object.tableId);
  writer.writeString(offsets[9], object.uuid);
}

KotCollection _kotCollectionDeserialize(
  Id id,
  IsarReader reader,
  List<int> offsets,
  Map<Type, List<int>> allOffsets,
) {
  final object = KotCollection();
  object.createdAt = reader.readDateTime(offsets[0]);
  object.id = id;
  object.items = reader.readObjectList<KotItemEmbedded>(
        offsets[1],
        KotItemEmbeddedSchema.deserialize,
        allOffsets,
        KotItemEmbedded(),
      ) ??
      [];
  object.notes = reader.readStringOrNull(offsets[2]);
  object.orderId = reader.readString(offsets[3]);
  object.orderType = reader.readString(offsets[4]);
  object.priority = reader.readLong(offsets[5]);
  object.station = reader.readString(offsets[6]);
  object.status = reader.readString(offsets[7]);
  object.tableId = reader.readStringOrNull(offsets[8]);
  object.uuid = reader.readString(offsets[9]);
  return object;
}

P _kotCollectionDeserializeProp<P>(
  IsarReader reader,
  int propertyId,
  int offset,
  Map<Type, List<int>> allOffsets,
) {
  switch (propertyId) {
    case 0:
      return (reader.readDateTime(offset)) as P;
    case 1:
      return (reader.readObjectList<KotItemEmbedded>(
            offset,
            KotItemEmbeddedSchema.deserialize,
            allOffsets,
            KotItemEmbedded(),
          ) ??
          []) as P;
    case 2:
      return (reader.readStringOrNull(offset)) as P;
    case 3:
      return (reader.readString(offset)) as P;
    case 4:
      return (reader.readString(offset)) as P;
    case 5:
      return (reader.readLong(offset)) as P;
    case 6:
      return (reader.readString(offset)) as P;
    case 7:
      return (reader.readString(offset)) as P;
    case 8:
      return (reader.readStringOrNull(offset)) as P;
    case 9:
      return (reader.readString(offset)) as P;
    default:
      throw IsarError('Unknown property with id $propertyId');
  }
}

  QueryBuilder<KotCollection, KotCollection, QAfterWhereClause> idNotEqualTo(
      Id id) {
    return QueryBuilder.apply(this, (query) {
      if (query.whereSort == Sort.asc) {
        return query
            .addWhereClause(
              IdWhereClause.lessThan(upper: id, includeUpper: false),
            )
            .addWhereClause(
              IdWhereClause.greaterThan(lower: id, includeLower: false),
            );
      } else {
        return query
            .addWhereClause(
              IdWhereClause.greaterThan(lower: id, includeLower: false),
            )
            .addWhereClause(
              IdWhereClause.lessThan(upper: id, includeUpper: false),
            );
      }
    });
  }

int _kotItemEmbeddedEstimateSize(
  KotItemEmbedded object,
  List<int> offsets,
  Map<Type, List<int>> allOffsets,
) {
  var bytesCount = offsets.last;
  {
    final value = object.modifiers;
    if (value != null) {
      bytesCount += 3 + value.length * 3;
    }
  }
  bytesCount += 3 + object.name.length * 3;
  {
    final value = object.notes;
    if (value != null) {
      bytesCount += 3 + value.length * 3;
    }
  }
  bytesCount += 3 + object.productId.length * 3;
  return bytesCount;
}

void _kotItemEmbeddedSerialize(
  KotItemEmbedded object,
  IsarWriter writer,
  List<int> offsets,
  Map<Type, List<int>> allOffsets,
) {
  writer.writeString(offsets[0], object.modifiers);
  writer.writeString(offsets[1], object.name);
  writer.writeString(offsets[2], object.notes);
  writer.writeString(offsets[3], object.productId);
  writer.writeDouble(offsets[4], object.quantity);
}

KotItemEmbedded _kotItemEmbeddedDeserialize(
  Id id,
  IsarReader reader,
  List<int> offsets,
  Map<Type, List<int>> allOffsets,
) {
  final object = KotItemEmbedded();
  object.modifiers = reader.readStringOrNull(offsets[0]);
  object.name = reader.readString(offsets[1]);
  object.notes = reader.readStringOrNull(offsets[2]);
  object.productId = reader.readString(offsets[3]);
  object.quantity = reader.readDouble(offsets[4]);
  return object;
}

P _kotItemEmbeddedDeserializeProp<P>(
  IsarReader reader,
  int propertyId,
  int offset,
  Map<Type, List<int>> allOffsets,
) {
  switch (propertyId) {
    case 0:
      return (reader.readStringOrNull(offset)) as P;
    case 1:
      return (reader.readString(offset)) as P;
    case 2:
      return (reader.readStringOrNull(offset)) as P;
    case 3:
      return (reader.readString(offset)) as P;
    case 4:
      return (reader.readDouble(offset)) as P;
    default:
      throw IsarError('Unknown property with id $propertyId');
  }
}

part 'fnb_reservation_collection.g.dart';

@collection
class FnbReservationCollection {
  Id id = Isar.autoIncrement;

  @Index(unique: true, replace: true)
  late String uuid;

  @Index()
  late String customerName;
  
  @Index()
  late String phone;

  @Index()
  late DateTime reservationDate;
  
  late DateTime startTime;
  late DateTime endTime;
  
  late int guestCount;
  
  String? tableId;
  String? section;

  @Index()
  late String status; // pending, confirmed, seated, completed, cancelled, no_show

  double? depositAmount;
  late String depositStatus; // unpaid, paid, refunded, forfeited

  String? notes;
  late String createdBy;
  late DateTime createdAt;
}

        upper: id,
      ));
    });

  QueryBuilder<FnbReservationCollection, FnbReservationCollection,
      QAfterWhereClause> idNotEqualTo(Id id) {
    return QueryBuilder.apply(this, (query) {
      if (query.whereSort == Sort.asc) {
        return query
            .addWhereClause(
              IdWhereClause.lessThan(upper: id, includeUpper: false),
            )
            .addWhereClause(
              IdWhereClause.greaterThan(lower: id, includeLower: false),
            );
      } else {
        return query
            .addWhereClause(
              IdWhereClause.greaterThan(lower: id, includeLower: false),
            )
            .addWhereClause(
              IdWhereClause.lessThan(upper: id, includeUpper: false),
            );

ProductCollection _productCollectionDeserialize(
  Id id,
  IsarReader reader,
  List<int> offsets,
  Map<Type, List<int>> allOffsets,
) {
  final object = ProductCollection();
  object.ageRestriction = reader.readLongOrNull(offsets[0]);
  object.aisleLocation = reader.readStringOrNull(offsets[1]);
  object.allergens = reader.readStringList(offsets[2]);
  object.allowRoomFolio = reader.readBoolOrNull(offsets[3]);
  object.apparelCategory = reader.readStringOrNull(offsets[4]);
  object.artisanLabel = reader.readStringOrNull(offsets[5]);
  object.bakeTimestamp = reader.readDateTimeOrNull(offsets[6]);
  object.bakeryType = reader.readStringOrNull(offsets[7]);
  object.barcode = reader.readStringOrNull(offsets[8]);
  object.baseNotes = reader.readStringOrNull(offsets[9]);
  object.basePrice = reader.readDouble(offsets[10]);
  object.batches = reader.readObjectList<BatchEmbed>(
    offsets[11],
    BatchEmbedSchema.deserialize,
    allOffsets,
    BatchEmbed(),
  );
  object.brandId = reader.readStringOrNull(offsets[12]);
  object.brandRange = reader.readStringOrNull(offsets[13]);
  object.businessCategory = reader.readStringOrNull(offsets[14]);
  object.businessType = reader.readStringOrNull(offsets[15]);
  object.cafeCategory = reader.readStringOrNull(offsets[16]);
  object.calories = reader.readDoubleOrNull(offsets[17]);
  object.careGuide = reader.readStringOrNull(offsets[18]);
  object.categoryId = reader.readString(offsets[19]);
  object.channelEligibility = reader.readStringList(offsets[20]);
  object.closureType = reader.readStringOrNull(offsets[21]);
  object.coldStorageIndicator = reader.readBoolOrNull(offsets[22]);
  object.collectionEdition = reader.readStringOrNull(offsets[23]);
  object.comboItems = reader.readStringList(offsets[24]);
  object.compatibility = reader.readStringOrNull(offsets[25]);
  object.concentration = reader.readStringOrNull(offsets[26]);
  object.containerType = reader.readStringOrNull(offsets[27]);
  object.conversionFactor = reader.readDoubleOrNull(offsets[28]);
  object.countryOfOrigin = reader.readStringOrNull(offsets[29]);
  object.createdAt = reader.readDateTime(offsets[30]);
  object.cuisineType = reader.readStringOrNull(offsets[31]);
  object.cupSizes = reader.readStringList(offsets[32]);
  object.description = reader.readString(offsets[33]);
  object.dietaryBadges = reader.readStringList(offsets[34]);
  object.division = reader.readStringOrNull(offsets[35]);
  object.exclusiveSinglePiece = reader.readBoolOrNull(offsets[36]);
  object.expiryWarningThreshold = reader.readLongOrNull(offsets[37]);
  object.fastMovingFlag = reader.readBoolOrNull(offsets[38]);
  object.featuredProduct = reader.readBoolOrNull(offsets[39]);
  object.fitType = reader.readStringOrNull(offsets[40]);
  object.flavorProfile = reader.readStringOrNull(offsets[41]);
  object.floorZone = reader.readStringOrNull(offsets[42]);
  object.foodCategory = reader.readStringOrNull(offsets[43]);
  object.foodClass = reader.readStringOrNull(offsets[44]);
  object.fragranceFamily = reader.readStringOrNull(offsets[45]);
  object.freshnessDuration = reader.readLongOrNull(offsets[46]);
  object.freshnessUnit = reader.readStringOrNull(offsets[47]);
  object.fruitBases = reader.readStringList(offsets[48]);
  object.gemstoneCount = reader.readLongOrNull(offsets[49]);
  object.gender = reader.readStringOrNull(offsets[50]);
  object.grossWeight = reader.readDoubleOrNull(offsets[51]);
  object.gstTaxMode = reader.readStringOrNull(offsets[52]);
  object.hairType = reader.readStringOrNull(offsets[53]);
  object.hallmarkCert = reader.readStringOrNull(offsets[54]);
  object.hotelDepartment = reader.readStringOrNull(offsets[55]);
  object.id = id;
  object.imei = reader.readStringOrNull(offsets[56]);
  object.importDutyClass = reader.readStringOrNull(offsets[57]);
  object.ingredients = reader.readStringOrNull(offsets[58]);
  object.ingredientsSummary = reader.readStringOrNull(offsets[59]);

  Future<int> deleteAllByBarcode(List<String?> barcodeValues) {
    final values = barcodeValues.map((e) => [e]).toList();
    return deleteAllByIndex(r'barcode', values);
  }

  int deleteAllByBarcodeSync(List<String?> barcodeValues) {
    final values = barcodeValues.map((e) => [e]).toList();
    return deleteAllByIndexSync(r'barcode', values);
  }

  Future<Id> putByBarcode(ProductCollection object) {
    return putByIndex(r'barcode', object);
  }

  Id putByBarcodeSync(ProductCollection object, {bool saveLinks = true}) {
    return putByIndexSync(r'barcode', object, saveLinks: saveLinks);
  }

  Future<List<Id>> putAllByBarcode(List<ProductCollection> objects) {
    return putAllByIndex(r'barcode', objects);
  }

  List<Id> putAllByBarcodeSync(List<ProductCollection> objects,
      {bool saveLinks = true}) {
    return putAllByIndexSync(r'barcode', objects, saveLinks: saveLinks);
  }
}

    return QueryBuilder.apply(this, (query) {
      if (query.whereSort == Sort.asc) {

              IdWhereClause.lessThan(upper: id, includeUpper: false),

    on QueryBuilder<ProductCollection, ProductCollection, QQueryProperty> {

int _categoryCollectionEstimateSize(
  CategoryCollection object,
  List<int> offsets,
  Map<Type, List<int>> allOffsets,
) {
  var bytesCount = offsets.last;
  bytesCount += 3 + object.name.length * 3;
  {
    final value = object.parentId;
    if (value != null) {
      bytesCount += 3 + value.length * 3;
    }
  }
  bytesCount += 3 + object.uuid.length * 3;
  return bytesCount;
}

void _categoryCollectionSerialize(
  CategoryCollection object,
  IsarWriter writer,
  List<int> offsets,
  Map<Type, List<int>> allOffsets,
) {
  writer.writeBool(offsets[0], object.isDeleted);
  writer.writeString(offsets[1], object.name);
  writer.writeString(offsets[2], object.parentId);
  writer.writeString(offsets[3], object.uuid);
}

CategoryCollection _categoryCollectionDeserialize(
  Id id,
  IsarReader reader,
  List<int> offsets,
  Map<Type, List<int>> allOffsets,
) {
  final object = CategoryCollection();
  object.id = id;
  object.isDeleted = reader.readBool(offsets[0]);
  object.name = reader.readString(offsets[1]);
  object.parentId = reader.readStringOrNull(offsets[2]);
  object.uuid = reader.readString(offsets[3]);
  return object;
}

    default:

  }

int _brandCollectionEstimateSize(
  BrandCollection object,
  List<int> offsets,
  Map<Type, List<int>> allOffsets,
) {
  var bytesCount = offsets.last;
  bytesCount += 3 + object.name.length * 3;
  bytesCount += 3 + object.uuid.length * 3;
  return bytesCount;
}

void _brandCollectionSerialize(
  BrandCollection object,
  IsarWriter writer,
  List<int> offsets,
  Map<Type, List<int>> allOffsets,
) {
  writer.writeBool(offsets[0], object.isDeleted);
  writer.writeString(offsets[1], object.name);
  writer.writeString(offsets[2], object.uuid);
}

BrandCollection _brandCollectionDeserialize(
  Id id,
  IsarReader reader,
  List<int> offsets,
  Map<Type, List<int>> allOffsets,
) {
  final object = BrandCollection();
  object.id = id;
  object.isDeleted = reader.readBool(offsets[0]);
  object.name = reader.readString(offsets[1]);
  object.uuid = reader.readString(offsets[2]);
  return object;
}

P _brandCollectionDeserializeProp<P>(
  IsarReader reader,
  int propertyId,
  int offset,
  Map<Type, List<int>> allOffsets,
) {
  switch (propertyId) {
    case 0:
      return (reader.readBool(offset)) as P;
    case 1:
      return (reader.readString(offset)) as P;
    case 2:
      return (reader.readString(offset)) as P;
    default:
      throw IsarError('Unknown property with id $propertyId');
  }
}

        lower: id,
        upper: id,
      ));
    });
  }

  QueryBuilder<BrandCollection, BrandCollection, QAfterWhereClause>
      idNotEqualTo(Id id) {
    return QueryBuilder.apply(this, (query) {
      if (query.whereSort == Sort.asc) {
        return query
            .addWhereClause(
              IdWhereClause.lessThan(upper: id, includeUpper: false),
            )
            .addWhereClause(
              IdWhereClause.greaterThan(lower: id, includeLower: false),
            );
      } else {
        return query
            .addWhereClause(
              IdWhereClause.greaterThan(lower: id, includeLower: false),
            )
            .addWhereClause(
              IdWhereClause.lessThan(upper: id, includeUpper: false),
            );
      }
    });
  }

  QueryBuilder<BrandCollection, BrandCollection, QAfterWhereClause>
      idGreaterThan(Id id, {bool include = false}) {

      );
    });

      Id id,

    return QueryBuilder.apply(this, (query) {
      return query.addWhereClause(
        IdWhereClause.lessThan(upper: id, includeUpper: include),
      );
    });

        value: [uuid],
      ));
    });
  }

  QueryBuilder<BrandCollection, BrandCollection, QAfterWhereClause>

      if (query.whereSort == Sort.asc) {
        return query
            .addWhereClause(IndexWhereClause.between(
              indexName: r'uuid',
              lower: [],
              upper: [uuid],
              includeUpper: false,
            ))
            .addWhereClause(IndexWhereClause.between(
              indexName: r'uuid',
              lower: [uuid],
              includeLower: false,
              upper: [],
            ));
      } else {
        return query
            .addWhereClause(IndexWhereClause.between(
              indexName: r'uuid',
              lower: [uuid],
              includeLower: false,
              upper: [],
            ))
            .addWhereClause(IndexWhereClause.between(

int _warehouseCollectionEstimateSize(
  WarehouseCollection object,
  List<int> offsets,
  Map<Type, List<int>> allOffsets,
) {
  var bytesCount = offsets.last;
  bytesCount += 3 + object.address.length * 3;
  bytesCount += 3 + object.code.length * 3;
  bytesCount += 3 + object.name.length * 3;
  bytesCount += 3 + object.uuid.length * 3;
  return bytesCount;
}

void _warehouseCollectionSerialize(
  WarehouseCollection object,
  IsarWriter writer,
  List<int> offsets,
  Map<Type, List<int>> allOffsets,
) {
  writer.writeString(offsets[0], object.address);
  writer.writeString(offsets[1], object.code);
  writer.writeBool(offsets[2], object.isDeleted);
  writer.writeBool(offsets[3], object.isMain);
  writer.writeString(offsets[4], object.name);
  writer.writeString(offsets[5], object.uuid);
}

WarehouseCollection _warehouseCollectionDeserialize(
  Id id,
  IsarReader reader,
  List<int> offsets,
  Map<Type, List<int>> allOffsets,
) {
  final object = WarehouseCollection();
  object.address = reader.readString(offsets[0]);
  object.code = reader.readString(offsets[1]);
  object.id = id;
  object.isDeleted = reader.readBool(offsets[2]);
  object.isMain = reader.readBool(offsets[3]);
  object.name = reader.readString(offsets[4]);
  object.uuid = reader.readString(offsets[5]);
  return object;
}

  IsarReader reader,

    case 1:
      return (reader.readString(offset)) as P;
    case 2:
      return (reader.readBool(offset)) as P;
    case 3:
      return (reader.readBool(offset)) as P;
    case 4:
      return (reader.readString(offset)) as P;
    case 5:
      return (reader.readString(offset)) as P;
    default:
      throw IsarError('Unknown property with id $propertyId');
  }

extension WarehouseCollectionQueryWhere

    return QueryBuilder.apply(this, (query) {
      return query.addWhereClause(IdWhereClause.between(
        lower: id,
        upper: id,
      ));
    });
  }

  QueryBuilder<WarehouseCollection, WarehouseCollection, QAfterWhereClause>
      idNotEqualTo(Id id) {
    return QueryBuilder.apply(this, (query) {
      if (query.whereSort == Sort.asc) {
        return query
            .addWhereClause(
              IdWhereClause.lessThan(upper: id, includeUpper: false),
            )
            .addWhereClause(
              IdWhereClause.greaterThan(lower: id, includeLower: false),
            );
      } else {
        return query
            .addWhereClause(
              IdWhereClause.greaterThan(lower: id, includeLower: false),
            )
            .addWhereClause(
              IdWhereClause.lessThan(upper: id, includeUpper: false),
            );
      }
    });
  }

  QueryBuilder<WarehouseCollection, WarehouseCollection, QAfterWhereClause>
      idGreaterThan(Id id, {bool include = false}) {
    return QueryBuilder.apply(this, (query) {
      return query.addWhereClause(
        IdWhereClause.greaterThan(lower: id, includeLower: include),
      );
    });
  }

  QueryBuilder<WarehouseCollection, WarehouseCollection, QAfterWhereClause>
      idLessThan(Id id, {bool include = false}) {
    return QueryBuilder.apply(this, (query) {
      return query.addWhereClause(
        IdWhereClause.lessThan(upper: id, includeUpper: include),
      );
    });
  }

      } else {

    });

  QueryBuilder<WarehouseCollection, WarehouseCollection, QAfterWhereClause>

        return query
            .addWhereClause(IndexWhereClause.between(
              indexName: r'name',
              lower: [],
              upper: [name],
              includeUpper: false,
            ))
            .addWhereClause(IndexWhereClause.between(
              indexName: r'name',
              lower: [name],
              includeLower: false,
              upper: [],
            ));
      } else {
        return query
            .addWhereClause(IndexWhereClause.between(
              indexName: r'name',
              lower: [name],
              includeLower: false,
              upper: [],
            ))
            .addWhereClause(IndexWhereClause.between(
              indexName: r'name',
              lower: [],
              upper: [name],
              includeUpper: false,
            ));
      }
    });
  }

  }

  QueryBuilder<WarehouseCollection, WarehouseCollection, QDistinct>

int _stockItemCollectionEstimateSize(
  StockItemCollection object,
  List<int> offsets,
  Map<Type, List<int>> allOffsets,
) {
  var bytesCount = offsets.last;
  bytesCount += 3 + object.productId.length * 3;
  bytesCount += 3 + object.warehouseId.length * 3;
  return bytesCount;
}

void _stockItemCollectionSerialize(
  StockItemCollection object,
  IsarWriter writer,
  List<int> offsets,
  Map<Type, List<int>> allOffsets,
) {
  writer.writeDateTime(offsets[0], object.lastUpdated);
  writer.writeString(offsets[1], object.productId);
  writer.writeDouble(offsets[2], object.quantity);
  writer.writeDouble(offsets[3], object.reservedQuantity);
  writer.writeString(offsets[4], object.warehouseId);
}

  object.quantity = reader.readDouble(offsets[2]);

  return object;
}

int _supplierRelationshipEmbedEstimateSize(
  SupplierRelationshipEmbed object,
  List<int> offsets,
  Map<Type, List<int>> allOffsets,
) {
  var bytesCount = offsets.last;
  {
    final value = object.notes;
    if (value != null) {
      bytesCount += 3 + value.length * 3;
    }
  }
  {
    final value = object.paymentTerms;
    if (value != null) {
      bytesCount += 3 + value.length * 3;
    }
  }
  {
    final value = object.supplierName;
    if (value != null) {
      bytesCount += 3 + value.length * 3;
    }
  }
  {
    final value = object.supplierProductName;
    if (value != null) {
      bytesCount += 3 + value.length * 3;
    }
  }
  {
    final value = object.supplierSku;
    if (value != null) {
      bytesCount += 3 + value.length * 3;
    }
  }
  {
    final value = object.uuid;
    if (value != null) {
      bytesCount += 3 + value.length * 3;
    }
  }
  return bytesCount;
}

void _supplierRelationshipEmbedSerialize(
  SupplierRelationshipEmbed object,
  IsarWriter writer,
  List<int> offsets,
  Map<Type, List<int>> allOffsets,
) {
  writer.writeBool(offsets[0], object.isPrimary);
  writer.writeLong(offsets[1], object.leadTime);
  writer.writeLong(offsets[2], object.moq);
  writer.writeString(offsets[3], object.notes);
  writer.writeString(offsets[4], object.paymentTerms);
  writer.writeDouble(offsets[5], object.purchaseCost);
  writer.writeString(offsets[6], object.supplierName);
  writer.writeString(offsets[7], object.supplierProductName);
  writer.writeString(offsets[8], object.supplierSku);
  writer.writeString(offsets[9], object.uuid);
}

  Id id,
  IsarReader reader,

) {
  final object = SupplierRelationshipEmbed();
  object.isPrimary = reader.readBoolOrNull(offsets[0]);
  object.leadTime = reader.readLongOrNull(offsets[1]);
  object.moq = reader.readLongOrNull(offsets[2]);
  object.notes = reader.readStringOrNull(offsets[3]);
  object.paymentTerms = reader.readStringOrNull(offsets[4]);
  object.purchaseCost = reader.readDoubleOrNull(offsets[5]);
  object.supplierName = reader.readStringOrNull(offsets[6]);
  object.supplierProductName = reader.readStringOrNull(offsets[7]);
  object.supplierSku = reader.readStringOrNull(offsets[8]);
  object.uuid = reader.readStringOrNull(offsets[9]);
  return object;
}

  IsarReader reader,
  int propertyId,
  int offset,
  Map<Type, List<int>> allOffsets,

  switch (propertyId) {
    case 0:
      return (reader.readBoolOrNull(offset)) as P;
    case 1:
      return (reader.readLongOrNull(offset)) as P;
    case 2:
      return (reader.readLongOrNull(offset)) as P;
    case 3:
      return (reader.readStringOrNull(offset)) as P;
    case 4:
      return (reader.readStringOrNull(offset)) as P;
    case 5:
      return (reader.readDoubleOrNull(offset)) as P;
    case 6:
      return (reader.readStringOrNull(offset)) as P;
    case 7:
      return (reader.readStringOrNull(offset)) as P;
    case 8:
      return (reader.readStringOrNull(offset)) as P;
    case 9:
      return (reader.readStringOrNull(offset)) as P;
    default:
      throw IsarError('Unknown property with id $propertyId');
  }
}

import 'package:isar/isar.dart';

part 'logistics_collections.g.dart';

@collection
class DeliveryOrderCollection {
  Id id = Isar.autoIncrement;

  @Index(unique: true, replace: true)
  late String uuid;

  @Index()
  late String salesOrderId;

  @Index()
  late String customerId;

  late String address;

  @Index()
  late String
      status; // pending, assigned, picked_up, out_for_delivery, delivered, failed, returned, cancelled

  DateTime? expectedTime;
  DateTime? pickedUpTime;
  DateTime? actualTime; // deliveredTime

  String? driverId;
  String? vehicleId;

  String? otp;
  String? signatureUrl;
  String? notes;
  double deliveryCharges = 0.0;
}

@collection
class VehicleCollection {
  Id id = Isar.autoIncrement;

  @Index(unique: true, replace: true)
  late String uuid;

  @Index(unique: true)
  late String plateNumber;

  late String model;
  late String type; // bike, van, truck

  bool isActive = true;
}

@collection
class DriverCollection {
  Id id = Isar.autoIncrement;

  @Index(unique: true, replace: true)
  late String uuid;

  @Index(caseSensitive: false)
  late String name;

  late String phone;
  late String licenseNumber;

  @Index()
  late String status; // on_duty, off_duty, on_break
}

  QueryBuilder<DeliveryOrderCollection, DeliveryOrderCollection,
      QAfterWhereClause> idNotEqualTo(Id id) {
    return QueryBuilder.apply(this, (query) {
      if (query.whereSort == Sort.asc) {
        return query
            .addWhereClause(
              IdWhereClause.lessThan(upper: id, includeUpper: false),
            )
            .addWhereClause(
              IdWhereClause.greaterThan(lower: id, includeLower: false),
            );
      } else {
        return query
            .addWhereClause(
              IdWhereClause.greaterThan(lower: id, includeLower: false),
            )
            .addWhereClause(
              IdWhereClause.lessThan(upper: id, includeUpper: false),
            );
      }
    });
  }

int _vehicleCollectionEstimateSize(
  VehicleCollection object,
  List<int> offsets,
  Map<Type, List<int>> allOffsets,
) {
  var bytesCount = offsets.last;
  bytesCount += 3 + object.model.length * 3;
  bytesCount += 3 + object.plateNumber.length * 3;
  bytesCount += 3 + object.type.length * 3;
  bytesCount += 3 + object.uuid.length * 3;
  return bytesCount;
}

void _vehicleCollectionSerialize(
  VehicleCollection object,
  IsarWriter writer,
  List<int> offsets,

) {
  writer.writeBool(offsets[0], object.isActive);
  writer.writeString(offsets[1], object.model);
  writer.writeString(offsets[2], object.plateNumber);
  writer.writeString(offsets[3], object.type);
  writer.writeString(offsets[4], object.uuid);
}

VehicleCollection _vehicleCollectionDeserialize(

  final object = VehicleCollection();

  object.model = reader.readString(offsets[1]);
  object.plateNumber = reader.readString(offsets[2]);
  object.type = reader.readString(offsets[3]);
  object.uuid = reader.readString(offsets[4]);
  return object;
}

  }

    return QueryBuilder.apply(this, (query) {
      if (query.whereSort == Sort.asc) {
        return query
            .addWhereClause(
              IdWhereClause.lessThan(upper: id, includeUpper: false),
            )
            .addWhereClause(
              IdWhereClause.greaterThan(lower: id, includeLower: false),
            );
      } else {
        return query
            .addWhereClause(
              IdWhereClause.greaterThan(lower: id, includeLower: false),
            )
            .addWhereClause(
              IdWhereClause.lessThan(upper: id, includeUpper: false),
            );
      }
    });

int _driverCollectionEstimateSize(
  DriverCollection object,
  List<int> offsets,
  Map<Type, List<int>> allOffsets,
) {
  var bytesCount = offsets.last;
  bytesCount += 3 + object.licenseNumber.length * 3;
  bytesCount += 3 + object.name.length * 3;
  bytesCount += 3 + object.phone.length * 3;
  bytesCount += 3 + object.status.length * 3;
  bytesCount += 3 + object.uuid.length * 3;
  return bytesCount;
}

void _driverCollectionSerialize(
  DriverCollection object,
  IsarWriter writer,

  Map<Type, List<int>> allOffsets,
) {
  writer.writeString(offsets[0], object.licenseNumber);
  writer.writeString(offsets[1], object.name);
  writer.writeString(offsets[2], object.phone);
  writer.writeString(offsets[3], object.status);
  writer.writeString(offsets[4], object.uuid);
}

DriverCollection _driverCollectionDeserialize(
  Id id,
  IsarReader reader,
  List<int> offsets,
  Map<Type, List<int>> allOffsets,
) {
  final object = DriverCollection();
  object.id = id;
  object.licenseNumber = reader.readString(offsets[0]);
  object.name = reader.readString(offsets[1]);
  object.phone = reader.readString(offsets[2]);
  object.status = reader.readString(offsets[3]);
  object.uuid = reader.readString(offsets[4]);
  return object;
}

  IsarReader reader,

      return (reader.readString(offset)) as P;

    case 4:
      return (reader.readString(offset)) as P;

      throw IsarError('Unknown property with id $propertyId');
  }

@collection
class ReportDefinitionCollection {
  Id id = Isar.autoIncrement;

  @Index(unique: true, replace: true)
  late String uuid;

  @Index(caseSensitive: false)
  late String name;

  late String description;

  @Index()
  late String module; // sales, inventory, finance, etc.

  late String dataSource; // Collection name or specialized view

  late String reportType; // table, pivot, barChart, lineChart, etc.

  List<String> selectedFields = [];

  String? groupByField;

  String? sortByField;
  bool sortDescending = true;

  String? aggregationJson; // JSON string for Sum/Avg/Count logic

  String? filtersJson; // JSON string for custom filter conditions

  String? visualSettingsJson; // Colors, labels, etc.

  @Index()
  late String ownerId;

  List<String> sharedWithRoleIds = [];

  bool isPredefined = false;

  DateTime createdAt = DateTime.now();
  DateTime updatedAt = DateTime.now();
}

class ReportScheduleCollection {
  Id id = Isar.autoIncrement;

  @Index(unique: true, replace: true)
  late String uuid;

  @Index()
  late String reportId;

  late String frequency; // daily, weekly, monthly

  late String deliveryChannel; // inApp, email, push

  List<String> recipientEmails = [];

  late DateTime nextRun;

  bool isActive = true;

  DateTime createdAt = DateTime.now();
}

  DashboardDefinitionCollection object,

  bytesCount += 3 + object.scope.length * 3;
  bytesCount += 3 + object.title.length * 3;
  bytesCount += 3 + object.uuid.length * 3;
  return bytesCount;
}

            .addWhereClause(IndexWhereClause.between(
              indexName: r'ownerId',
              lower: [ownerId],
              includeLower: false,
              upper: [],
            ))
            .addWhereClause(IndexWhereClause.between(
              indexName: r'ownerId',
              lower: [],
              upper: [ownerId],
              includeUpper: false,
            ));
      }
    });
  }
}

  ReportScheduleCollection object,
  List<int> offsets,
  Map<Type, List<int>> allOffsets,
) {
  var bytesCount = offsets.last;
  bytesCount += 3 + object.deliveryChannel.length * 3;
  bytesCount += 3 + object.frequency.length * 3;
  bytesCount += 3 + object.recipientEmails.length * 3;
  {
    for (var i = 0; i < object.recipientEmails.length; i++) {
      final value = object.recipientEmails[i];
      bytesCount += value.length * 3;
    }
  }
  bytesCount += 3 + object.reportId.length * 3;
  bytesCount += 3 + object.uuid.length * 3;
  return bytesCount;
}

  bytesCount += 3 + object.maritalStatus.length * 3;
  bytesCount += 3 + object.name.length * 3;
  bytesCount += 3 + object.phone.length * 3;
  {
    final value = object.photoUrl;
    if (value != null) {
      bytesCount += 3 + value.length * 3;
    }
  }
  {
    final value = object.salaryStructureId;
    if (value != null) {
      bytesCount += 3 + value.length * 3;
    }
  }
  {
    final value = object.shiftId;
    if (value != null) {
      bytesCount += 3 + value.length * 3;
    }
  }
  bytesCount += 3 + object.skills.length * 3;
  {
    for (var i = 0; i < object.skills.length; i++) {
      final value = object.skills[i];
      bytesCount += value.length * 3;
    }
  }
  {
    final value = object.state;
    if (value != null) {
      bytesCount += 3 + value.length * 3;
    }
  }
  bytesCount += 3 + object.status.length * 3;
  {
    final value = object.userId;
    if (value != null) {
      bytesCount += 3 + value.length * 3;
    }
  }
  bytesCount += 3 + object.uuid.length * 3;
  {
    final value = object.whatsapp;
    if (value != null) {
      bytesCount += 3 + value.length * 3;
    }
  }
  {
    final value = object.workLocation;
    if (value != null) {
      bytesCount += 3 + value.length * 3;
    }
  }
  {
    final value = object.zipCode;
    if (value != null) {
      bytesCount += 3 + value.length * 3;
    }
  }
  return bytesCount;
}

            .addWhereClause(IndexWhereClause.between(
              indexName: r'designationId',
              lower: [designationId],
              includeLower: false,
              upper: [],
            ));
      } else {
        return query
            .addWhereClause(IndexWhereClause.between(
              indexName: r'designationId',
              lower: [designationId],
              includeLower: false,
              upper: [],
            ))
            .addWhereClause(IndexWhereClause.between(
              indexName: r'designationId',
              lower: [],
              upper: [designationId],
              includeUpper: false,
            ));
      }
    });
  }

  QueryBuilder<EmployeeCollection, EmployeeCollection, QAfterWhereClause>
      statusEqualTo(String status) {
    return QueryBuilder.apply(this, (query) {
      return query.addWhereClause(IndexWhereClause.equalTo(
        indexName: r'status',
        value: [status],
      ));
    });
  }

  QueryBuilder<EmployeeCollection, EmployeeCollection, QAfterWhereClause>
      statusNotEqualTo(String status) {
    return QueryBuilder.apply(this, (query) {
      if (query.whereSort == Sort.asc) {
        return query
            .addWhereClause(IndexWhereClause.between(
              indexName: r'status',
              lower: [],
              upper: [status],
              includeUpper: false,
            ))
            .addWhereClause(IndexWhereClause.between(
              indexName: r'status',
              lower: [status],
              includeLower: false,
              upper: [],
            ));
      } else {
        return query
            .addWhereClause(IndexWhereClause.between(
              indexName: r'status',
              lower: [status],
              includeLower: false,
              upper: [],
            ))
            .addWhereClause(IndexWhereClause.between(
              indexName: r'status',
              lower: [],
              upper: [status],
              includeUpper: false,
            ));
      }
    });
  }

int _attendanceCollectionEstimateSize(
  AttendanceCollection object,
  List<int> offsets,
  Map<Type, List<int>> allOffsets,
) {
  var bytesCount = offsets.last;
  bytesCount += 3 + object.employeeId.length * 3;
  {
    final value = object.shiftId;
    if (value != null) {
      bytesCount += 3 + value.length * 3;
    }
  }
  bytesCount += 3 + object.source.length * 3;
  return bytesCount;
}

  AttendanceCollection object,
  IsarWriter writer,

) {

  writer.writeDateTime(offsets[1], object.clockOut);
  writer.writeString(offsets[2], object.employeeId);
  writer.writeBool(offsets[3], object.isEarlyDeparture);
  writer.writeBool(offsets[4], object.isLate);
  writer.writeDouble(offsets[5], object.latitude);
  writer.writeDouble(offsets[6], object.longitude);
  writer.writeDouble(offsets[7], object.overtimeHours);
  writer.writeString(offsets[8], object.shiftId);
  writer.writeString(offsets[9], object.source);
}

  Id id,

) {
  final object = AttendanceCollection();

  object.clockOut = reader.readDateTimeOrNull(offsets[1]);
  object.employeeId = reader.readString(offsets[2]);
  object.id = id;
  object.isEarlyDeparture = reader.readBool(offsets[3]);
  object.isLate = reader.readBool(offsets[4]);
  object.latitude = reader.readDoubleOrNull(offsets[5]);
  object.longitude = reader.readDoubleOrNull(offsets[6]);
  object.overtimeHours = reader.readDouble(offsets[7]);
  object.shiftId = reader.readStringOrNull(offsets[8]);
  object.source = reader.readString(offsets[9]);

}

extension AttendanceCollectionQueryWhere
    on QueryBuilder<AttendanceCollection, AttendanceCollection, QWhereClause> {
  QueryBuilder<AttendanceCollection, AttendanceCollection, QAfterWhereClause>
      idEqualTo(Id id) {
    return QueryBuilder.apply(this, (query) {
      return query.addWhereClause(IdWhereClause.between(
        lower: id,
        upper: id,
      ));
    });
  }

  QueryBuilder<AttendanceCollection, AttendanceCollection, QAfterWhereClause>
      idNotEqualTo(Id id) {
    return QueryBuilder.apply(this, (query) {
      if (query.whereSort == Sort.asc) {
        return query
            .addWhereClause(
              IdWhereClause.lessThan(upper: id, includeUpper: false),
            )
            .addWhereClause(
              IdWhereClause.greaterThan(lower: id, includeLower: false),
            );
      } else {
        return query
            .addWhereClause(
              IdWhereClause.greaterThan(lower: id, includeLower: false),
            )
            .addWhereClause(
              IdWhereClause.lessThan(upper: id, includeUpper: false),
            );
      }
    });
  }

  QueryBuilder<AttendanceCollection, AttendanceCollection, QAfterWhereClause>
      idGreaterThan(Id id, {bool include = false}) {
    return QueryBuilder.apply(this, (query) {
      return query.addWhereClause(
        IdWhereClause.greaterThan(lower: id, includeLower: include),
      );
    });
  }

  QueryBuilder<AttendanceCollection, AttendanceCollection, QAfterWhereClause>
      idLessThan(Id id, {bool include = false}) {
    return QueryBuilder.apply(this, (query) {
      return query.addWhereClause(
        IdWhereClause.lessThan(upper: id, includeUpper: include),
      );
    });
  }

  QueryBuilder<AttendanceCollection, AttendanceCollection, QAfterWhereClause>

int _payrollCollectionEstimateSize(
  PayrollCollection object,
  List<int> offsets,
  Map<Type, List<int>> allOffsets,
) {
  var bytesCount = offsets.last;
  {
    final value = object.bankReference;
    if (value != null) {
      bytesCount += 3 + value.length * 3;
    }
  }
  bytesCount += 3 + object.employeeId.length * 3;
  {
    final value = object.glTransactionId;
    if (value != null) {
      bytesCount += 3 + value.length * 3;
    }
  }
  bytesCount += 3 + object.month.length * 3;
  bytesCount += 3 + object.uuid.length * 3;
  return bytesCount;
}

void _payrollCollectionSerialize(
  PayrollCollection object,
  IsarWriter writer,
  List<int> offsets,
  Map<Type, List<int>> allOffsets,
) {
  writer.writeDouble(offsets[0], object.allowances);
  writer.writeString(offsets[1], object.bankReference);
  writer.writeDouble(offsets[2], object.basicSalary);
  writer.writeDouble(offsets[3], object.bonuses);
  writer.writeDouble(offsets[4], object.deductions);
  writer.writeString(offsets[5], object.employeeId);
  writer.writeString(offsets[6], object.glTransactionId);
  writer.writeDouble(offsets[7], object.hra);
  writer.writeBool(offsets[8], object.isPaid);
  writer.writeString(offsets[9], object.month);
  writer.writeDouble(offsets[10], object.netAmount);
  writer.writeDouble(offsets[11], object.overtimePay);
  writer.writeDateTime(offsets[12], object.paymentDate);
  writer.writeDouble(offsets[13], object.statutoryTaxes);
  writer.writeString(offsets[14], object.uuid);
}

PayrollCollection _payrollCollectionDeserialize(
  Id id,
  IsarReader reader,
  List<int> offsets,
  Map<Type, List<int>> allOffsets,
) {
  final object = PayrollCollection();
  object.allowances = reader.readDouble(offsets[0]);
  object.bankReference = reader.readStringOrNull(offsets[1]);
  object.basicSalary = reader.readDouble(offsets[2]);
  object.bonuses = reader.readDouble(offsets[3]);
  object.deductions = reader.readDouble(offsets[4]);
  object.employeeId = reader.readString(offsets[5]);
  object.glTransactionId = reader.readStringOrNull(offsets[6]);
  object.hra = reader.readDouble(offsets[7]);
  object.id = id;
  object.isPaid = reader.readBool(offsets[8]);
  object.month = reader.readString(offsets[9]);
  object.netAmount = reader.readDouble(offsets[10]);
  object.overtimePay = reader.readDouble(offsets[11]);
  object.paymentDate = reader.readDateTimeOrNull(offsets[12]);
  object.statutoryTaxes = reader.readDouble(offsets[13]);
  object.uuid = reader.readString(offsets[14]);
  return object;
}

P _payrollCollectionDeserializeProp<P>(
  IsarReader reader,
  int propertyId,
  int offset,
  Map<Type, List<int>> allOffsets,
) {
  switch (propertyId) {
    case 0:
      return (reader.readDouble(offset)) as P;
    case 1:
      return (reader.readStringOrNull(offset)) as P;
    case 2:
      return (reader.readDouble(offset)) as P;
    case 3:
      return (reader.readDouble(offset)) as P;
    case 4:
      return (reader.readDouble(offset)) as P;
    case 5:
      return (reader.readString(offset)) as P;
    case 6:
      return (reader.readStringOrNull(offset)) as P;
    case 7:
      return (reader.readDouble(offset)) as P;
    case 8:
      return (reader.readBool(offset)) as P;
    case 9:
      return (reader.readString(offset)) as P;
    case 10:
      return (reader.readDouble(offset)) as P;
    case 11:
      return (reader.readDouble(offset)) as P;
    case 12:
      return (reader.readDateTimeOrNull(offset)) as P;
    case 13:
      return (reader.readDouble(offset)) as P;
    case 14:
      return (reader.readString(offset)) as P;
    default:
      throw IsarError('Unknown property with id $propertyId');
  }
}

  QueryBuilder<PayrollCollection, PayrollCollection, QAfterWhereClause>
      idNotEqualTo(Id id) {
    return QueryBuilder.apply(this, (query) {
      if (query.whereSort == Sort.asc) {
        return query
            .addWhereClause(
              IdWhereClause.lessThan(upper: id, includeUpper: false),
            )
            .addWhereClause(
              IdWhereClause.greaterThan(lower: id, includeLower: false),
            );

        return query
            .addWhereClause(
              IdWhereClause.greaterThan(lower: id, includeLower: false),
            )
            .addWhereClause(
              IdWhereClause.lessThan(upper: id, includeUpper: false),
            );
      }
    });

    on QueryBuilder<PayrollCollection, PayrollCollection, QSortBy> {
  QueryBuilder<PayrollCollection, PayrollCollection, QAfterSortBy>

int _leaveCollectionEstimateSize(
  LeaveCollection object,
  List<int> offsets,
  Map<Type, List<int>> allOffsets,
) {
  var bytesCount = offsets.last;
  {
    final value = object.approvedById;
    if (value != null) {
      bytesCount += 3 + value.length * 3;
    }
  }
  bytesCount += 3 + object.employeeId.length * 3;
  bytesCount += 3 + object.reason.length * 3;
  bytesCount += 3 + object.status.length * 3;
  bytesCount += 3 + object.type.length * 3;
  bytesCount += 3 + object.uuid.length * 3;
  return bytesCount;
}

void _leaveCollectionSerialize(
  LeaveCollection object,
  IsarWriter writer,
  List<int> offsets,
  Map<Type, List<int>> allOffsets,
) {
  writer.writeString(offsets[0], object.approvedById);
  writer.writeString(offsets[1], object.employeeId);
  writer.writeDateTime(offsets[2], object.endDate);
  writer.writeString(offsets[3], object.reason);
  writer.writeDateTime(offsets[4], object.startDate);
  writer.writeString(offsets[5], object.status);
  writer.writeString(offsets[6], object.type);
  writer.writeString(offsets[7], object.uuid);
}

LeaveCollection _leaveCollectionDeserialize(
  Id id,
  IsarReader reader,
  List<int> offsets,
  Map<Type, List<int>> allOffsets,
) {
  final object = LeaveCollection();
  object.approvedById = reader.readStringOrNull(offsets[0]);
  object.employeeId = reader.readString(offsets[1]);
  object.endDate = reader.readDateTime(offsets[2]);
  object.id = id;
  object.reason = reader.readString(offsets[3]);
  object.startDate = reader.readDateTime(offsets[4]);
  object.status = reader.readString(offsets[5]);
  object.type = reader.readString(offsets[6]);
  object.uuid = reader.readString(offsets[7]);
  return object;
}

P _leaveCollectionDeserializeProp<P>(
  IsarReader reader,
  int propertyId,
  int offset,
  Map<Type, List<int>> allOffsets,
) {
  switch (propertyId) {
    case 0:
      return (reader.readStringOrNull(offset)) as P;
    case 1:
      return (reader.readString(offset)) as P;
    case 2:
      return (reader.readDateTime(offset)) as P;
    case 3:
      return (reader.readString(offset)) as P;
    case 4:
      return (reader.readDateTime(offset)) as P;
    case 5:
      return (reader.readString(offset)) as P;
    case 6:
      return (reader.readString(offset)) as P;
    case 7:
      return (reader.readString(offset)) as P;
    default:
      throw IsarError('Unknown property with id $propertyId');
  }

    return QueryBuilder.apply(this, (query) {
      return query.addWhereClause(IdWhereClause.between(
        lower: id,
        upper: id,
      ));
    });
  }

  QueryBuilder<DepartmentCollection, DepartmentCollection, QAfterWhereClause>
      idNotEqualTo(Id id) {
    return QueryBuilder.apply(this, (query) {
      if (query.whereSort == Sort.asc) {
        return query
            .addWhereClause(
              IdWhereClause.lessThan(upper: id, includeUpper: false),
            )
            .addWhereClause(
              IdWhereClause.greaterThan(lower: id, includeLower: false),
            );
      } else {
        return query
            .addWhereClause(
              IdWhereClause.greaterThan(lower: id, includeLower: false),
            )
            .addWhereClause(
              IdWhereClause.lessThan(upper: id, includeUpper: false),
            );
      }
    });
  }

int _designationCollectionEstimateSize(
  DesignationCollection object,
  List<int> offsets,
  Map<Type, List<int>> allOffsets,
) {
  var bytesCount = offsets.last;
  bytesCount += 3 + object.name.length * 3;
  bytesCount += 3 + object.uuid.length * 3;
  return bytesCount;
}

  DesignationCollection object,
  IsarWriter writer,
  List<int> offsets,

  writer.writeString(offsets[0], object.name);
  writer.writeString(offsets[1], object.uuid);
}

  Id id,

  List<int> offsets,

  final object = DesignationCollection();
  object.id = id;

  object.uuid = reader.readString(offsets[1]);
  return object;
}

P _designationCollectionDeserializeProp<P>(
  IsarReader reader,
  int propertyId,
  int offset,
  Map<Type, List<int>> allOffsets,

  switch (propertyId) {
    case 0:
      return (reader.readString(offset)) as P;
    case 1:
      return (reader.readString(offset)) as P;
    default:
      throw IsarError('Unknown property with id $propertyId');
  }
